en: Who is he who possesses heigh goodness without haughtiness
who is he who graces minds with goodness so that confusion is severed
who is he who is the overlord of the immortals in whom tiredness is severed?
Rise in worship to [his] glowing feet by which misery is severed, my mind
He who is without measure by the perception of the mind, who rises in the spotless blossom
inside the mind, he who is without [the range of] those sense perceptions
perceive the whole goodness of him who is like this: he who is without one like him
in future, present and past, what is he, he wo is without age, abounding in life?
He is difficult to think as “he is without that, he possesses this”
on earth [and] in heaven he is with and is without form
he is not an intellect with senses, he is without end
we have reached the one who possesses that goodness which is spread
We, he there, he here, he in between, she there, she here, she in between which one?
They there, they here, they in between, that, this, that in between what?
Those that are perishing, these, those ones, those good ones, those bad ones
those becoming, those who have become being [all this] it is he who stands there
gloss: participial noun, neuter plural, perfective aspect

en: Those who approach [his] feet, each saying “he is the lord”
in any manner known to each of them
being lords over them all, being without want
they all are established close to the ordained way of the lord
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: He stood, sat, lay, wandered
he did not stand, sit, lay, wander
he who is difficult to think as one with one nature always
he is our firm point who remains with one nature always
He who exists, spread out everywhere, hidden like the soul in the body
in all those, being the whole pervading matter/meaning
in these: the firm sky, fire, wind, water, earth
[he is] the god who is in these [words of] aural teaching abounding in lustre
The Highest of the high who is the whole of those, being the first Cause
of the whole in heaven, of a state difficult to know for the gods
igniting three cities with one [arrow], surpassing the knowledge of the immortals
he exists, destroying [and] creating the world as Hara and Aja
If one says “he exists”, the form of him who exists is these forms
if one says “he does not exist”, his non-form is these non-forms
In the possession of these as qualities: “he is” or “he is not”
he is with two qualities, spreading he is without end
He exists, spread out in every water on the cool expanse that is spread out
without end earth [and] sky as “this is the cosmic egg that is spread out”
in any few place that are hidden, in every matter/meaning shining in [those] places
he exists spread out everywhere in hiding, the Firm one who is [all] these
These ten in the thousand arranged in a row
spoken by Caṭakōpaṉ from Kurukūr on the feet of the Highest
who stood as a mountain of god-uttering(?) power, strength [and] care
in these: bright(?) sky, fire, wind, water [and] ground
[mean] liberation
Die! Make a house in him who possesses liberation
for your souls, entirely making the liberation
When they call the bodies of the creatures
without stability, like lightning, consider the lord, you
These called “you, yours”, destroy at the roots, the lord
join, for the soul there is no fullness like that
Beyond not being and being his form
is without boundary, That goodness embrace, seize thus
If attachment ceases, the soul experiences liberation
If permanently experiencing control thus grasp the lord
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect
neuter singular, perfective aspect, verbal noun

en: He is without attachment and the lord totally stands [there]
You being without attachment yield to his perfection
Submissively seeing the wealth of comprised beauty
saying “that is the beauty comprised in the lord” may you yield, oh mind
Thinking of [and] overcoming these Three which are
thought, word [and] act submit in [your] mind to the lord
As soon as you have submissely submitted to him, after
letting go of everything think of the time you let go of the body
Just join the firm ankleted feet of Nāraṇaṉ, of generous fame
without end, bright wealth/meaning, of that goodness that multiplies in number
These ten in the thousand of the excellent wreath are regarded
as the word of Caṭakōpaṉ from southern Kurukūr with trees joining
The one who is easy [to reach] for [his] devout servants, is for others a difficult
mysterious person; the flower lady desires the feet difficult to reach for us
oh the ease with which he sobbed, staying joined to the mortar in which manner?
after having been tied by [his] strong waist for the theft of butter which trickled when experiencing the churning rod
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

en: He is of a nature easy [and] difficult. Being in many births, without limits of position
he is the whole effulgent goodness, liberation without beginning, without end
He is without an end that would be of a quality that is understood, the lord of the whole
suited to be the one inside [and] outside, with a grace that is nourishing
Being high without being lofty on the whole path of befitting Dharma
he fully is the ground inmidst the befitting beginning [and] the destructive annihilation
He is the befitting immortals, everything and everyone
Who are those that will understand the Māyā of befitting Nāraṇaṉ
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: For anybody our lord is difficult to know as one of a single state
For anybody our lord is easy to know as one of a single state
A thousand names and many others possesses our lord
[There is] a disagreement [as to whether] he is not one with name and form or whether he is not without
Standing of the path of penance, possessing reverence for the endless
primordial lord who told good things without count, thinking
of the path of heterodox systems of six kinds so that diagreement would cease
taking the perception of him [and] perceiving so that attachment ends
dry up the ties to be removed on the outer path
Perceiving, perceiving, falling, departing, rising, wondering at the form, even though
perceiving, perceiving, perceiving the this wonderful state, perceiving the state of the lord is difficult to perceive, oh living beings
Perceiving, perceiving, talking, talking about him called Hari, Aja [and] Hara
perceiving, perceiving, talking, talking bow, agreeing as one
gloss: neuter singular, perfective aspect, verbal noun

en: Remembering these called the very graceful Nāraṇaṉ, who stood in forms difficult
to know as one [and] as many, the four-faced one [and] Hara
putting [them] in your minds as one, cutting off your great/two attachments
is doing good that is good in him [during] our days
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

en: Standing daily our deadly ancient cruel deeds will die all together
There will be not one lack. Cleansing fully enough the inside of [our] mind
daily bowing to the good ankletted [feet] of the lord who possesses Śrī
even one time when dying with obeissance dying will be gain
On [his] right [is] the one who burned the three cities. While the good world, which the one
with a face in [every] direction created in seven areas, and he obtain place in [his] navel
he himself is moreover inside his world, for the senses to perceive
When one enters speaking about these, moreover these that are in [his] belly [are] his bond/distraction(?)
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect

en: He who masters the things that are great in heaven, confusing illusions
that hold the immortals spellbound with knowledgable hearts, with bond-free minds
he with the dark colour of rain clouds, I cannot forget the buds [which are his] good feet
that traversed the vast ground, I shall talk on, I shall embrace, I shall constantly bow
Those who master these ten among the thousand of abiding [sweet] taste
the small services of Caṭakōpaṉ from fertile Kurukūr with suitable groves
on him who churned the rolling sea, while the immortals rose in worship
they with go one height with the immortals [and] end the confinement in their births
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect

en: Pretty-winged youthful heron, have pity. You too having
your pretty-winged male, taking pity on me, [cowing] ā ā
when you go as an envoy sent by me to the one high on the hot-winged bird
if you were to undergo staying put if he put [you] in a strong cage, what would it do [to you]?
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, dative, perfective aspect

en: When you speak as my envoy to my lord with red lotus eyes
what would it do [to you], pleasing Koels? Won’t you?
I who did not exert myself formerly in doing menial service under the sacred feet
because of all the deeds done before, will that type of fate leave [me]?
gloss: neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

en: Soft-gaited geese who unite with [your] females by fate
speak
to the robber who begged for the earth as a glory of a dwarf, by [his] mind:
“a woman is confused, all [her] mind stirred up inside
saying ‘won’t the harsh deeds of me without mind be exhausted’.”
What will I speak with words to my man of blue cloud-colour
who, seeing my state, does not lament [and] say: “this is not right”?
Speak with one mouth, good blue Makaṉṟils: “now the good state will
not stay with her.” Will you grant [that], will you not?
gloss: pronominalised noun, dative, honorific, third person

en: Will it not be that he grants [his presence] to me whose Karma are the seven groves
he graciously protects [and] takes care of? When you see Nāraṇaṉ
generous little heron searching for prey in the gardens by flood of rising waters
graciously take with you one word from me with eyes of rising water
gloss: pronominalised noun, dative, singular, first person
pronominalised noun, dative, singular, first person

en: “You who are ungracious be gracious, before her breath dries up
urge [your] bird with the gracious discus into her street one day!”
When you see the lord with the gracious discus, graciously say
this, bee with round stripes. In what have we failed?
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, plural, first person

en: As if stringing bones for jewels the chilly north winds saw
To Tirumāl who is ungracious, graciously thinking of my failings
speak with one voice: “how did she fail in propriety against the holy feet?”
young parrots who fail me. Won’t you, whom I have raised?
gloss: neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

en: [It’s] you, isn’t it, little mynah? When [I] said “as my messenger
to the great Māl talk of my pain”, without talking [of it] at all you stayed perched
I dimmed in sapphire-darkness, along with [my] grace. Search now
for someone [else] to put sweet food in your beak
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person
participial noun, accusative, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: It is appointed to seek unsought blossoms every day
[and] place [them] under the unfading blossom feet of Nāraṇaṉ
Playing release, sitting enthroned, what [good] will it do for cutting off [my] deeds
o roaming chilly north wind, you being one that wears away my body?
gloss: neuter singular, perfective aspect, verbal noun
participial noun, perfective aspect, plural, second person
pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person

en: When you see the lord with the deadly discus
who closes [his] eyes on him who appears in ring form in the sea
as life begins with birth [and] ends in release, in the circle of bodies
speak this
[and] sink to be released, foolish heart. We carry karma as long as we are one [with it]
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, oblique, perfective aspect

en: If one utters the wealth of these ten in the measured Antāti thousand
excellently composed by Catakōpaṉ from liberal Kurukūr surrounded
by fertile paddy fields, on his great lord Kaṇṇaṉ of seven worlds he advanced to measure
there will be obtaining of profit great to the height of the sky

ta: வளவே ழுலகின் முதலாய் வானோ ரிறையை யருவினையேன்
களவேழ் வெண்ணெய் தொடுவுண்ட கள்வா வென்பன் பின்னையுந்
தளவேழ் முறுவல் பின்னைக்காய் வல்லா னாயர் தலைவனா
யிளவே றேழுந் தழுவிய வெந்தா யென்ப னினைந்துநைந்தே
en: To the lord of the celestials, being the cause of the fertile seven worlds, I of difficult karma
say “o robber who touched [and] ate the butter lifted by theft”, and after
thinking, I faintly say “my father who embraced the seven young bulls
as the leader of the herders of strong cows for the sake of Piṉṉai in whose smile jasmine-[bud-like teeth] rise.”

ta: நினைந்து நைந்துள் கரைந்துருகி யிமையோர் பலரு முனிவரும்
புனைந்த கண்ணி நீர்சாந்தம் புகையோ டேந்தி வணங்கினா
னினைந்த வெல்லாப் பொருள்கட்கும் வித்தாய் முதலில் சிதையாமே
மனஞ்செய் ஞானத் துன்பெருமை மாசூ ணாதோ மாயோனே
en: If, thinking, swooning, weeping [and] melting inside, the many unblinking ones and the sages
offer decorative chaplets, water [and] sandal with incense [and] bow
with [you] as the seed of all matters thought of, in the beginning is there loss?
Will not your greatness of mind-made knowledge absorb [all] flaw, Dark one?
gloss: participial noun, negative, honorific, third person

ta: மாயோ னிகளாய் நடைகற்ற வானோர் பலரு முனிவரு
நீயோ னிகளைப் படையென்று நிறைநான் முகனைப் படைத்தவன்
சேயோ னெல்லா வறிவுக்குந் திசைக ளெல்லாந் திருவடியா
றாயோ னெல்லா வெவ்வுயிர்க்குந் தாயோன் றானோ ருருவனே
en: He who created the one with four faces, saying “you create the wombs
for the sages and many of the immortals who learned to walk as great wombs”
the one who is distant, the one extended his holy feet over all the directions
for all knowledge, the one who expanded all living beings, he is of one form
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

ta: தானோ ருருவே தனிவித்தாய்த் தன்னின் மூவர் முதலாய
வானோர் பலரு முனிவரு மற்று மற்று முற்றுமாய்
தானோர் பெருநீர் தன்னுள்ளே தோற்றி யதனுள் கண்வளரும்
வானோர் பெருமான் மாமாயன் வைகுந் தனெம் பெருமானே
en: He is one form. Being a single seed, from that becoming many of the celestials
who have the Three as a beginning, sages, all the others and everything
the lord of the celestials who made it appear on the great water, inside himself
[and] who sleeps in it, the great/dark trickster, the one from Vaikunta is our great lord

ta: மானேய் நோக்கி மடவாளை மார்விற் கொண்டாய் மாதவா
கூனே சிதைய வுண்டைவி னிறத்தி றெறித்தாய் கோவிந்தா
வானார் சோதி மணிவண்ணா மதுசூ தாநீ யருளாயுன்
றேனே மலருந் திருப்பாதஞ் சேரு மாறு வினையேனே
en: You who take to [your] chest the yourful girl with deer-like glances, o Mātava
you who who broke the bow quality of the ball so that [its] humps were spoiled, o Govinda
light of the celestials, sapphire-coloured one, Madhusūdana, you grace
me of [bad] karma with a way to join your honey-blossoming sacred feet
gloss: participial noun, singular, second person, perfective aspect
participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person

ta: வினையேன் வினைதீர் மருந்தானாய் விண்ணோர் தலைவா கேசவா
மனைசே ராயர் குலமுதலே மாமா யன்னே மாதவா
சினையேய் தழைய மராமரங்க ளேழு மெய்தாய் சிரீதரா
வினையா யினைய பெயரினா யென்று நைவ னடியேனே
en: “Being the one who is a remedy that ends the karma of me who has [bad] karma, leader of the celestials, Keśava
first in the clan of the cowherds that join the house, great/dark trickster, Mādava
you who shot the seven Kadamba trees with foliage on [their] branches, Śrīdhara
you who are like this, who have names like these” thus I languish, I who am [your] servant
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person

ta: அடியேன் சிறிய ஞானத்த னறித லார்க்கு மரியானைக்
கடிசேர் தண்ணந் துழாய்க்கண்ணி புனைந்தான் றன்னைக் கண்ணனைச்
செடியா ராக்கை யடியாரைச் சேர்த றீர்க்குந் திருமாலை
யடியேன் காண்பா னலற்றுவ னிதனின் மிக்கோ ரயர்வுண்டே
en: I [his] servant am of little knowledge. The one who is difficult to know for anybody
the one who is decorated with a fragrant cool Tulsi chaplet, Kaṇṇaṉ
Tirumāl who end [his] servants’ joining the bodies of sinful/troubled people
in order to see him I [his] servant keep talking. Is there any oblivion greater than this?
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, accusative, honorific, third person

ta: உண்டா யுலகேழ் முன்னமே யுமிழ்ந்து மாயை யால்புக்
குண்டாய் வெண்ணெய் சிறுமனிச ருவலை யாக்கை நிலையெய்தி
மண்டான் சோர்ந்த துண்டேலு மனிசர்க் காகும் பீர்சிறிது
மண்டா வண்ண மண்கரைய நெய்யூண் மருந்தோ மாயோனே
en: You ate the seven worlds once, after having spit [them] out. Having entered by magic
reaching a position in the frail body of small humans you ate the butter
even though the earth itself slipped [out] it is for the humans. So that the earth was dissolved
in a manner that a little white was [still] there, [was] eating butter the remedy, o Dark one?

ta: மாயோந் தீய வலவலைப் பெருமா வஞ்சப் பேய்வீய
தூய குழவி யாய்விடப்பா லமுதா வமுது செய்திட்ட
மாயன் வானோர் தனித்தலைவன் மலராண் மைந்த னெவ்வுயிர்க்குந்
தாயோன் றம்மா னென்னம்மா னம்மா மூர்த்தி யைச்சார்ந்தே
en: We won’t perish
reaching that great/dark form of my lord, the lord who expanded
for all living beings, the husband of her on the blossom, the sole leader of the celestials, the trickster
who made ambrosia, the ambrosia being the milk when emitted by the mother of the pure calf
while the big dark treacherous demoness of evil confusion perished
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

ta: சார்ந்த விருவல் வினைகளுஞ் சரித்து மாயப் பற்றறுத்துத்
தீர்ந்து தன்பான் மனம்வைக்கத் திருத்தி வீடு திருத்துவா
னார்ந்த ஞானச் சுடராகி யகலங் கீழ்மே லளவிறந்து
நேர்ந்த வுருவா யருவாகு மிவற்றி னுயிரா நெடுமாலே
en: Toppling the two/big harsh karmas that had reached [me], gripping [them] by magic, cutting [them] off
so that [I] finally put [my] mind on him, he who arranges release
being the full glow of knowledge, goying beyond the measure of the earth below [and] above
being the appropriate form he becomes formless, the tall Māl who is the life of all these
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, imperfective aspect

ta: மாலே மாயப் பெருமானே மாமா யன்னே யென்றென்று
மாலே யேறி மாலருளான் மன்னு குருகூர்ச் சடகோபன்
பாலேய் தமிழ ரிசைகாரர் பத்தர் பரவு மாயிரத்தின்
பாலே பட்ட விவைபத்தும் வல்லார்க் கில்லை பரிவதே
en: To those who master these ten that make a part
in the thousand, that are revered by those who [know] milk-like Tamil, music makers [and] devotees
of Caṭakōpaṉ from Kurukūr that lasts by the grace of Māl
ascending only to Māl, repeating “Māl, wondrous great man, great miraculous one”
there will be no want
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

en: Singing the lord without suffering
experience/undertake being attached to spreading
incense [and] flowers and in performing
by sprinkling good water without [any] kind of separation
gloss: neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun
neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun
neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

en: For the one with the honey-flowing cool Tulsi
him who is the first in the ancient Vedas
without saying “what is the cause, which is the service”
that alone is the application that makes one a servant
Without any application or plan, the lord’s
place my mind does not let go of
my tongue sing songs for him
my body dances [like] a demon
Like a demon dances my body
it bows [and] worships the lord
according to the meritorious tenet
by which the immortals rave in unison
The one without tenet [or] non-tenet
the one without a passion for deriding [others]
desirous of not breaking what may unfold
for those confused in mind [he is] the one ambrosia
gloss: participial noun, dative, perfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: Neṭumāl with a glowing discus he holds up
who gave the ambrosia to the immortals
he is much sweeter than ambrosia
the one who is on the large sea with high waves
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

en: He who cut into pieces the arms [and] heads
of the king of Ilaṅkai surrounded by the large sea
bowing on the head to [his] feet
let the days go by
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, third person, perfective aspect

en: Let them pass, slaves. Making [them] pass
worship. If you worship him
making die [your] harsh karma that stands in the way
he will give [you] bodies free from decay
The sole husband of the lady Śrī
who is the rare fruit of dharma
the lord who possesses greatness
will expell [your] twofold karma
He will expell evil karmas
with a snap of [his] finger
beautiful Mādava
who raise the killing bird as [his] banner
Those who are able to recite
these ten in the imperishable thousand
spoken without fiery penance
by Caṭakōpaṉ on Mādava
will not be reborn
So that the misery of [re]birth be severed, those who, standing in the world
put on [their] heads the glowing lamp of renunciation
without forgettfulness will put in [their] minds
the gracious one with the discus weapon on the serpent bed
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: The treasure is he, the remedy is he who does not permit
[his] severants harsh karma so that the five sense sleep that are the force [of it]
Ascending [and] ascending through goodness of everyone in every part
he is of that part, our sprout of the cowherd clan
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, third person, negative

en: Drinking in [and] drinking in the pure ambrosia
my ruby light, the lord of illusion
who, as the sprout of the cowherd clan, was thrashed by them
I have cut off the confusion of my illusory [re]birth
gloss: pronominalised noun, instrumental, honorific, third person

en: Him who remains in my mind so that confusion is cut off
the bundle of bright light that brings elevation
the tireless primary sprout of the immortals
my contentment saying what shall I give [him] up?
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect

en: Will I let go of my light, my soul
the leader who came in the middle [and] managed to escape(?)
the lord who opened the eyes, committing theft
committing licentiousness among the young cowherder women?
The lord, the one who moreover split the great ground
the one with a crown fragrantly covered by blooming Tulsi
the trickster who shot the Cadamba trees, if he
is not in my heart, will I stick to him?
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect

en: I did not say “I will stick [and] let [him] be in my heart
He, sticking, coming, deceiving my solitary heart
sticking to [my] flesh, constantly mingled with my life breath
will his kind stick when they cut me loose?
And if he were to cut me loose, even he himself
cannot make my good heart leave him now
powerful when delighting in the large bamboo shoulders of Piṉṉai
he who once was the whole base of the immortals
The beginning who became the whole base of the immortals
the sprout of the cowherders who gave the ambrosia to the immortals
my soul, stirring to be closely intimate with him
embraced abiding [with him]. Now wil there be leaving?
If one leaves he leaves. If one comes close he comes close
He is difficult to enter, he is without equal, our lord
Singing the praise of him who is matchless we are without fatigue
day and night settling [and] toiling
These ten in the thousand of the wreath of words set close
by Caṭakōpaṉ from southern Kurukūr who approaches
the one with the Tulsi crown worked through [and] eaten by bees
will break [and] chase away pains
Mounted on the racing bird
he wears cool Tulsi
playfully the father
creates things that last long
gloss: participial noun, neuter plural, perfective aspect

en: Even after being the father
he is Kṛṣṇa with large red eyes
who split the mouth of the cruel horse
who was our glorious man
He who always is eye is the lord
of the celestials’ Vēṅkaṭa mountain
filled with coolness
for those of the earth [and] the celestials
gloss: singular, masculine, third person, imperfective aspect
pronominalised noun, dative, honorific, third person

en: The father who stands
lifting a mountain
without weakness
his praise I repeat daily
Who daily ate, mingling
[his] hand in the butter
without falseness mingling
he mingled with my body
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
singular, masculine, third person, perfective aspect

en: As he mingled with my soul
the lord who took my goodness
as a boy who captures the senses
he took the earth
He who took the seven bulls
he who ate the seven worlds
making it a cool place
he himself became my thoughts
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: He who became cowherd
fish and boar
he became the conch
that is in me
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, masculine

en: He who holds in [his] palms
the conch [and] the discus
is our lord
who became himself everywhere
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: The lord, the one with feet
that took the world, my father
has water [colour] like the sea
[and] the nature of the shining Veda
Listening to these among the thousand
by excellent Caṭakōpaṉ
on the one of water-like colour
is being in agreement

ta: இவையு மவையு முவையு மிவரு மவரு முவரு
மவையும் யவருந்தன் னுள்ளே யாகியு மாக்கியுங் காக்கு
மவையு டனிமுத லெம்மான் கண்ண பிரானென் னமுதஞ்
சுவையன் றிருவின் மணாள னென்னுடைச் சூழலு ளானே
en: Who guards inside himself, becoming and creating [them], those things and people:
these things, the things there, those things, this people, the people there, those people
the sole cause among those, our lord, lord Kaṇṇaṉ, my one with the taste
of ambrosia, the husband of Śrī, he is inside my mind

ta: சூழல் பலபல வல்லான் றொல்லையங் காலத் துலகை
கேழலொன் றாகியி டந்த கேசவ னென்னுடை யம்மான்
வேழ மருப்பையொ சித்தான் விண்ணவர்க் கெண்ண லரியா
னாழ நெடுங்கடல் சேர்ந்தா னவனென் னருகலி லானே
en: The one who can encompass many many, Keśava who in old times
becoming a boar scooped up the world, my father
the one who broke the elephant’s tusk, the one difficult to think for the celestials
the one who joined the deep large sea, he is in my proximity
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, dative, honorific, third person
participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

ta: அருகலி லாய பெருஞ்சீ ரமரர்க ளாதி முதல்வன்
கருகிய நீலநன் மேனி வண்ணன்செந் தாமரைக் கண்ணன்
பொருசிறைப் புள்ளுவந் தேறும் பூமக ளார்தனிக் கேள்வ
னொருகதி யின்சுவை தந்திட் டொழிவில னென்னோ டுடனே
en: The first beginning of the immortals of great excellence who are close
the one with darkened blue colour on [his] good body, Kṛṣṇa with red lotus eyes
the only husband of the flower lady who joyfully mounts a bird with beating wings
the one who, giving the taste of a refuge, is without end is with me

ta: உடனமர் காதன் மகளிர் திருமகண் மண்மக ளாயர்
மடமக ளென்றிவர் மூவ ராளு முலகமு மூன்றே
யுடனவை யொக்க விழுங்கி யாலிலைச் சேர்ந்தவ னெம்மான்
கடன்மலி மாயப் பெருமான் கண்ணனெ னொக்கலை யானே
en: Who rules over the beloved woman with whom together he resides, these three
namely lady Śrī, lady Earth and an youthful daughter if the cowherds, who joined
a Banyan leaf after having swallowed all the three worlds, so as to be harmoniously together
our lord, the great lord of ample Māyā on the sea, Kṛṣṇa is part of my body
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect

ta: ஒக்கலை வைத்து முலைப்பா லுண்ணென்று தந்திட வாங்கிச்
செக்கஞ் செகவன் றவள்பா லுயிர்செக வுண்ட பெருமா
னக்க பிரானோ டயனு மிந்திர னும்முத லாக
வொக்கவுந் தோற்றிய வீசன் மாய னென்னெஞ்சி னுளானே
en: The great lord who, when she put [him] to [her] body [and] gave [him her] breast
saying “drink milk”, dragged [her] destructively that day [and] drank her milk
so as to destroy [her] life, the smiling lord who harmoniously created
along with lord [Śiva], Ayaṉ and Indra as the first, the Dark one is in my heart

ta: மாயனென் னெஞ்சி னுள்ளான் மற்றும் யவர்க்கு மதுவே
காயமுஞ் சீவனுந் தானே காலு மெரியு மவனே
சேய னணியன் யவர்க்குஞ் சிந்தைக்குங் கோசர மல்லன்
றூயன் றுயக்கன் மயக்க னென்னுடைத் தோளிணை யானே
en: The Dark one is in my heart. It is not for anybody else
Body and soul is he. Wind and fire is he
Far is he, near is he, he no sense object for anyone’s thoughts
The pure, sorrow[-bringing], confusing one is by my shoulder pair
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

ta: தோளிணை மேலுநன் மார்பின் மேலுஞ் சுடர்முடி மேலுந்
தாளிணை மேலும் புனைந்த தண்ணந் துழாயுடை யம்மான்
கேளிணை யொன்றுமி லாதான் கிளருஞ் சுடரொளி மூர்த்தி
நாளணைந் தொன்று மகலா னென்னுடை நாவினு ளானே
en: The lord who has adorning cool Tulsi on [his] shoulder pair
on [his] good chest on [his] glowing crown and on [his] pair of feet
the one who is without any matching relative, the form of shining, glowing light
he who comes near [and] does not depart every single day, he is on my tongue

ta: நாவினு ணின்று மலரு ஞானக் கலைகளுக் கெல்லா
மாவியு மாக்கையுந் தானே யழிப்போ டளிப்பவன் றானே
பூவிய னாற்றடந் தோளன் பொருபடை யாழிசங் கேந்துங்
காவிநன் மேனிக் கமலக் கண்ணனென் கண்ணினு ளானே
en: Of all the arts of knowledge that bloom, standing on [my] tongue
soul and body is he, the one of provision along with destruction is he
he with four broad arms of flower nature, the one the good complexion of a blue lily
who holds up conch [and] discus as [his] fighting weapon, the one with lotus eyes is in my eyes
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, imperfective aspect

ta: கமலக் கண்ணனென் கண்ணினுள்ளான் காண்ப னவன்கண்க ளாலே
யமலங்க ளாக விழிக்கு மைம்புல னுமவன் மூர்த்தி
கமலத் தயன்நம்பி தன்னைக் கண்ணுத லானொடுந் தோற்றி
யமலத் தெய்வத்தோ டுலக மாக்கியென் நெற்றியு ளானே
en: The one with lotus eyes is in my eyes. I see him with [my] eyes
All [my] five sense look attentively at his form, so as to become spotless
Making appear the lord Ayaṉ from the lotus along with the one with the forehead eye
creating the world along with the spotless gods he is on my brow

ta: நெற்றியு ணின்றென்னை யாளு நிரைமலர்ப் பாதங்கள் சூடிக்
கற்றைத் துழாய்முடிக் கோலக் கண்ண பிரானைத் தொழுவா
ரொற்றைப் பிறையணிந் தானு நான்மு கனுமிந் திரனு
மற்றை யமரரு மெல்லாம் வந்தென துச்சியு ளானே
en: Wearing the full blossom feet that rule me, standing on [my] brow
they worship beautiful lord Kaṇṇaṉ, [his] crown with Tulsi in a bunch:
the one adorned with the unique crescent moon, the four-faced one, Intiraṉ
and all the other immortals. Having come he is in/on my head
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person

ta: உச்சி யுள்ளே நிற்குந் தேவ தேவற்குக் கண்ண பிராற்
கிச்சை யுள்செல் லவுணர்த்தி வண்குரு கூர்ச்சட கோப
னிச்சொன்ன வாயிரத் துளிவை யும்மோர் பத்தெம் பிராற்கு
நிச்சலும் விண்ணப் பம்செய்ய நீள்கழல் சென்னி பொருமே
en: When announcing [you] go into service to lord Kaṇṇaṉ
the god of gods who stands on top, [and] making a petition perpetually
to our lord by this one decade in these thousand spoken by Caṭakōpaṉ
from liberal Kurukūr, the head will beat against [his feet with] long anklets
With the fighting big long weapon, the discus, the conch
while the seven worlds worship [his] sacred big long anklet[ted feet]
that black ruby who strechted out after having become
a dwarf is what is in my eyes
He stands in [my] eye. Even if I count the services
[accomplished] through loving, what will come now? We want
our lord who expands as earth, water
fire, good winds and sky
Our lord, our father, the father, the fathers’
lord, Kṛṣṇa with cool lotus eyes
him on whose chest is [she with] a fine slim waist [like] a twig [or] a snake
our lord worship, foolish heart
O heart, you are good, you are good. If we have you
what can we not do? What do we lack now?
Without letting go even at the time of sleeping hold on
to the young man, the bridegroom of her on the flower, you who have seen [him]
You have seen, heart [our] karmas have culminated
the way [we] come [and] advance without even any calculation
you too saw [and] took in the one who has swallowed the seven worlds
him who took it in once three steps
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, accusative, perfective aspect

en: “If you and I stand before [him] henceforth he will not give room
to all the pains of others , o heart” I said
Being mother and father in this world
the lord prevails, the saphire-coloured one, our father
I put [him] into my thoughts [and] speak [of him]
as “our father” and “our lord”, I who am a sinner
of the lord whom the celestials put in [their] thoughts
[and] call “our father, our lord”
As soon as I hear the word that say “o lord, Nārāyaṇa”
tears well up in [my] eyes. I ponder the wonder
By night and by day without release
he grants [his presence and] does not let me go, Nampi, Nampi
Nampi, the brilliant form that shines with that
red gold who stays in southern Kuṟuṅkuṭi
the primordial effulgence of the celestials beyond
our lord, saying what will I forget him?
Both forgetting and knowledge I do not understand at all
Thinking “he will forget, with red lotus eyes
the one who dwells in my mind so that forgetting is cut off
will I forget now my sapphire?
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: If those who don’t slacken practice
with these ten among the serving thousand
spoken by Caṭakōpaṉ from southern Kurukūr on the jewel
on the Kaṇṇaṉ of the celestials [and] on his ornaments
[their] erudition will excell
Youthful herons of the seashore grove that leap the successive waves
even when mother and the tranquil world sleep you do not sleep
While pain and pallor press hard, like us
are you too caught at the heart by Tirumāl?
You whose mind has been captured, sharp-mouthed Aṉṟil
you will cry without joining distant midnights
Enslaved like us you too desire the cool Tulsi string
from the foot of the one on the serpent bed
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

en: With helplessness out of desire you will lament all day [and] night
[your] eyes totally without sleep, heart melting
Do you have what we had, who longed for the feet of him who fed
southern Lanka totally to the fire oh sounding sea?
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
participial noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect

en: Stirring sea and mountain and sky, like us
seized by heat you don’t sleep day [or] night, cool north wind
[longing] to see the lord with the discus as deathly seizing weapon
do you have bodily pain aeon after aeon?
Taking water to the world aeon after aeon
may you live, cloud, who is emaciated, being of a nature
like [our] friends and us. You too dwindle in the snare of his eye
suffering from Matucūtaṉ’s strength
You who waste away just like us, [one-]day moon! You who do not dispell
the darkness of the kajal sky today, let you become dim [and] fade
you who, after hearing as true the words of the great lord with the discus on
the five-mouthed serpent’s bed, you show your true nature
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person

en: As it is cruel against us who have shown [our] foolish heart
to our great lord Nāraṇaṉ [and] who cry, speaking of our lack of strength
you in the middle, why, in the manner of a stranger, would you
stand in enmity for an aeon, oh intense darkness?
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, plural, first person
participial noun, accusative, plural, first person

en: Backwater with dark water the colour of solid darkness, going
even if, being in confusion, day [and] night sleep you don’t sleep
You suffer, overwhelmed by great longing for the grace
of the great lord who kicked the rolling cart
As the pain of painfully unsatiable love dries up inside [your] soft soul
unwaxing lamp, you too are pitiable
You burn from longing for the cool Tulsi from the pretty string of our
great lord with large red lotus eyes [and] a red fruit mouth
As the pain of incessantly burning desire dries up inside my soft soul
without ceasing day [and] night, on your part, desist from making us fall
o unaging foremost one who rent the horse’s mouth, went between
the Marutam trees [and] measured the earth, when now we faint
Those who don’t tire
of these ten among the one thousand spoken
by Caṭakōpaṉ from Kurukūr in insatiable love
for our unwearying treasure, for the light that is the beginning
will firmly not be released from Vaikuntam, you see
Being the whole basis for firm good liberation
he is higher than thought, our great trickster
our Kṛṣṇa who swallowed all heaven and earth
apart from his eye, the is no eye
What sins are paramount in the seven worlds
who will by grace make these sins [vanish and] take care
if not the cow-herding bull of a murderous lion
who poured alms for Hara so that [his] great sin left?
Is there any god more than Māl
who took the earth by stretching [himself] out so that he placed himself above the highest [point]
putting inside himself, while heaven worships nothing else
the one on the bull, the one in the flower [and] the lady of the flower
Other than for the god, our lord
who created the four-faced one in the flower
so that he would create the gods and all things
are flowers and worship befitting?
Inside his sole base of befitting excellence
to create all the many gods and things
our lord Kṛṣṇa with befitting beautiful lotus eyes
who are those who know [any] above [him] in ample splendour?
He
the glowing form, a flood of pervasive knowledge
who stood retaining in himself without attachment
everyone, everything and all objects
is our ocean-bedded one
A banyan leaf as a bed, our lord with a strong stomach
that took the seven worlds, a liberal donor
who will know in [their] minds the intention
of his deceptive, illusive mind?
Except for the illusive lord who made grow
by [his] intention the gods and all things, who
is of the nature to perfectly create [and] guard
inside himself the three world of solid state?
The lord Kṛṣṇa who is of the nature to guard
the divine worlds, having made a union [with them]
brought into being the celestials, Indra [and]
the four-faced one who was formed inside his navel
Saying “o robber, lord who made appear inside
yourself both us and the seven worlds”
the one on the white bull the one with four faces, Indra [and] the celestials
humbly praise the anklet[ted feet] of [him on] the bird vehicle
For those able to praise
with these ten among the excellent thousand
spoken by Caṭakōpaṉ from Kurukūr on the beautiful
dancer who took the seven worlds while they were praising
the will be no deficiency
Living in the flesh, life, you are good. Go! Obtaining you
the great man of those who are in heaven, Madhusūdana, our lord
himself and I, we remain mingled inside all
similar to honey, milk, ghee and sugarcane
In great illusive power that are these you are equal
to great people who are equal. Being the life of every thing, being the mother
who begot me, being the father, o father who made [me] know the things
[I] don’t know, I, [your] devotee don’t know the things you did
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person
participial noun, accusative, perfective aspect, honorific, third person
participial noun, neuter plural, perfective aspect

en: In times out of knowledge you caused me to make love [to you] in servantship
[and] place, me [your servant, in [your] unknowable great illusion indeed
you who, mingling in my soul, as an unknown dwarf
deceived the ignorance of Māvali, saying “three steps”
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, accusative, first person
participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person
pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person

en: For the great good help of [your] mingling wirh my soul I remained
giving my soul in exchange. Now, is there [any] talk of it coming back?
You are the soul of my soul, my father who swallowed the seven groves
Who is my soul? Who am I? You who gave brought [it] into being by taking [it]
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person
pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person
neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun
verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect
pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person
pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person

en: Now who [is there] to weigh [you] by cognitions, my father who does not rise?
Pleasure of liberation, full of compassion, ambrosia that did not touch the sea
living basis of solitary me I joined the feet of you who as a boar
placed on [you] pointed tusk all the seven groves
gloss: participial noun, singular, second person, perfective aspect

en: O bane to the evil karma of those who join [you], firm mind
their life that does not separate from the minds of those who quit
effulgence that trickles [and] does not give going(?), you who sawed off
the nose of the rakṣasi, I [your] servant have finally reached you as [my] base
gloss: participial noun, third person, perfective aspect
participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person
participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person

en: Oh ripe taste of the strings that sound on the former(?) good lute
Highest one about who many good people talk, pure one
sugarcane, ambrosia, rain cloud, my Kṛṣṇa
I have nothing but you, take hold of me
What is all the penance done for aeons with tenacious knowledge?
Playing pranks for myself I have reached [the goal] in this birth in a few days
chasing the misery of birth as one whose heart takes the path
after the lord how secretly ate the butter [and] milk that were taken from the pot net
Kṛṣṇa with cool Tulsi overflowing with fragrance, the great lord of the celestials
the highest who goes beyond earth [and] sky, the pure one’s excellence
settling, working through, playing in [it] so that [my] sinful pains get lost
I [his] servant put [it] in [my] mouth, drank [and] was exulted
Cutting off intoxication and attraction, going beyond the fetter of birth, cutting off old age
being [with?] all the bright effulgence, when will there be uniting
with the throngs of servants of the illusive lord who takes care
holding up the glowing disk [and] the conch, of dripping sky and earth?
gloss: neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

en: Singing these ten in the numerous thousand
clearly spoken by Caṭakōpaṉ from crowded Southern Kurukūr
on the one who destructively hated the numerous big Rakṣasa family
in throngs, o servants join together [and] constantly dance
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, accusative, perfective aspect

en: Dancing, dancing, [her] heart dissolving, music
singing, singing, tears welling up, everywhere
searching, searching, saying “Narasiṃha!”
fading she fades [away], this [girl with] bright forehead
This simple [girl] with a bright forehead
languishes in longing to see you, who are without mercy
in [your] nature, when one sees you who cut off
the thousand shoulders of victorious Bhāṇa
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, plural, second person

en: This one resembles sealing wax
on a bed of flame, with a mind merciful
towards you who subdued Laṅkā [and its] king
You who don’t rise to mercy, what shall I do about it?
gloss: participial noun, dative, perfective aspect, plural, second person

en: You who subdued Laṅkā, she says. [Then] again
you who is elevated on the strong bird, she says. She sighs
hotly while [her] mind is confused. While tears well up
this one stirs [and] folds [her] hands in worship, constantly
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person

en: This one, speaking incoherently night [and] day
she has water in her water-lily bright eyes
Saying “give [me] the cool Tulsi touched by bees
are [these actions] befitting those of white colour?
gloss: participial noun, singular, feminine, perfective aspect

en: “O you who possess fitness”, she says, [then] again
“lord who is much desired”, she says, “ambrosia
that is befitting for my life”, she says, constantly
melting inside while [her] heart is rejoicing
“Inside, inside her soul is all dried up”
“o liberal man, o Kaṇṇaṉ”, she says, [then] again
“o you who lied on the water of the flood”, she says
O you deceiver that my secretive [girl] has fallen for
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect
participial noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect
participial noun, second person, perfective aspect

en: The time [the sun] sinks, the time it rises she doe not know
“O cool Tulsi with scented honey blossoms”, she says
You with the glowing, round, sharp-edged discus
what is you wish for this simple [girl]?
The simple girl, night [and] day she
holds water in her lustreless bright eyes
You who subdued Laṅkā so that [its] shining life burned
Don’t make fade any of her youthful looks!
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, plural, second person

en: Adorning [his] feet
with these ten among the one thousand of songs
fashioned in words, joining music, by generous
Caṭakōpaṉ on the Dwarf of unfading fame
is highest heaven
To the lord who joined my soul, making love [to me] in a pretty spot
there are a crown in which a pretty garland lives, a conch, a diskus, a thread [and] a necklace
on [his] red golden luminous body with red lotus feet
red lotusses, red fruit mouth [and] large red lotus eyes
Of him who mingled with my heart without any place that is renounced
the luminous body is of celestial lustre, red lotusses the eyes, the hand lotusses
[his] chest is the place of Śrī, [his] navel the place of the unborn one
is there also a place for Hara on the great lord, our father?
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, dative, perfective aspect

en: On the one who mingled with my soul, the flashing, glowing mountain
of red lotus with a red fruit mouth, [there] are eye, foot, [and] hand lotusses
in [his] belly there are the whole lasting seven worlds
The is no thing at all that is not mingled in him
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: Who, being every thing, resembles an emerald mountain
the lord of that time [has] lotus flowers eyes, hand [and] feet lotusses
All the times, day, month, year, aeon after aeon
those times [are] those times of the lord, my never-sating ambrosia
On Kṛṣṇa, my lord like a black cloud full of rain
who mingled with [my] dark soul, being never-sating ambrosia
red coral does not match [his] mouth, [nor] lotus [his] eye, hands, feet
many are [his] jewels, moreover a string, a tall crown, a big garland
Manny many the ornaments, the names many many
many many the luminous forms if one counts the qualities
many many the pleasures of seeing, absorbing, hearing, experiencing, smelling
many many the knowledges of him on the serpent bed
He abided on the serpent bed, on the milk ocean bed
he killed seven bulls together for the sake of Piṉṉai with bamboo-like shoulders
he shot seven Cadamba trees in the grove with sweet ponds(?)
the battle bull with a gold crown [and] cool Tulsi entwined with flowers
gloss: neuter singular, perfective aspect, verbal noun
verbal noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect
verbal noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect

en: About the battle bull with a gold crown, our lord, the one with a garland
of cool Tulsi without any limit to [his] four large arms
the one who mingled with my heart without seeing my limitations
I don’t see a limit of words; what shall I say, tell [me]?
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, accusative, perfective aspect
verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

en: Speak: my lord, the soul of my soul
my black ruby effulgence of boundless excellence
being good ambrosia and liberation difficult to obtain
he equals the scent of the water-lily blossom, he is not man, he is not woman
He is not man, he is not woman, besides, he is no man-woman
And he is impossible to see, he is not someone who is, he is not not
When one thinks [about him] he is the form one thinks and he is not
There is a big problem in talking about our lord
If there are those capable to recite
these ten in one thousand of Antāti that was recited
by Caṭakōpaṉ from Kurukūr, being attached to talking
about the lord who danced with pots whose [description] does not become full by any talk
they will join Vaikunta

ta: வைகுந்தா மணிவண்ணனே யென்பொல்லாத் திருகுறளா வென்னுண் மன்னி
செய்குந் தாவருந் தீமையுன் னடியார்க்குத் தீர்த்தசுரர்க்குத் தீமைகள்
en: O man from Vaikunta, sapphire-coloured one, dwelling in my heart as my wicked sacred dwarf
o divine bull who is ambrosia every passing day
o Kunda flower from the fields who ends the difficult evil for his servants [and] does evils to the Asuras
o Kunda, you I grip firmly take [me]

ta: சிக்கெனச் சிறிதோ ரிடமும் புறப்படாத் தன்னுள்ளே யுலகுக
மிக்க ஞான வெள்ளச் சுடர்விளக்காய்த் துளக்கற் றமுதமா யெங்கும்
en: Tightly, in his interior from which not one place gets out even a little, equally
swallowing the worlds he has entered. After entering
being a glowing lamp with an increasing flood of knowledge, sorrow ending, as ambrosia, everywhere
he does not know of looking aside, my fresh lotus-eyed Kṛṣṇa
gloss: singular, masculine, third person, perfective aspect
verbal noun, neuter singular, oblique, perfective aspect

ta: தாமரைக் கண்ணனை விண்ணோர் பரவுந் தலைமகனை துழாய்விரைப்
நாமருவி நன்கேத்தி யுள்ளி வணங்கி நாமகிழ்ந் தாட நாவலர்
en: The generous man has a nature that grants us jointly praising [him] well
as lotus-eyed Kṛṣṇa, as the leader whom the celestials rever, as our lord
with a joint chaplet of fragrant Tulsi flowers, as a golden mountain
thinking [of him], bowing, [our] tongues rejoicing [and] dancing
[and grants] the tongue experts standing [there], bringing together metres

ta: தெள்க றந்த வெந்தா யுன்னை யெங்ஙனம் விடுகேன்
வெள்ளமே புரை நின்புகழ் குடைந்தாடிப் பாடிக் களித்து கந்துகந்
en: O generous man, Madhusūdana, my emerald mountain, our father
who gives [me] thinking of you [and] slighting(?), how would I leave you
diving into your fame that is like a flood [and] dancing, singing being exulted, rejoicing, rejoicing
driving away all the pains that are there, escaping completely(?)

ta: உய்ந்து போந்தென் னுலப்பிலாத வெந்தீவினை களை நாசஞ் செய்துன
வைந்து பைம் தலை யாடர வணைமேவிப் பாற்கடல் யோக நித்திரை
சிந்தை செய்த வெந்தா யுன்னைச் சிந்தை செய்து செய்தே
en: Escaping completely, destroying my undiminuishing hot fiery karma
I reached your endless servantship will I let go [of you]?
constantly having you in [my] thoughts, our father who has thoughts
in yogic posture on the milk ocean, resting on the serpent bed whose five hooded heads move

ta: உன்னைச் சிந்தை செய்து செய்துன் னெடுமா மொழியிசை பாடியாடியென்
னுன்னை சிந்தையினா லிகழ்ந்த விரணிய னகன்மார்வங் கீண்ட வென்
en: Constantly having thoughts [of you], singing you with long great word music, dancing
I have cut off the whole root of my former fiery karma/evil deeds
O my former murderous lion who split the wide chest of Hiraṇya who slighted
you in thoughts, what would be impossible to me?
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect

ta: முடியாத தென்னெனக் கேலினி முழுவே ழுலகு முண்டா னுகந்துவந்
செடியார் நோய்க ளெல்லாந் துரந்தெமர் கீழ்மே லேழ்பிறப்பும்
en: What will be impossible to me? If so, the one who swallowed all the seven worlds joyfully came
[and] entered the heart of me, his servant, and he will not leave now
Abandoning all pains full of evil my people through seven birth before [and] after
have been changed from forever joining endless hot hell
gloss: conditional, pronoun, dative, singular, first person
participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
singular, masculine, third person, perfective aspect
participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person

ta: மாறி மாறிப் பலபிறப்பும் பிறந்தடியை யடைந்துள்ளந் தேறி
பாறிப் பாறி யசுரர்தம் பல்குழாங்க ணீறெழப் பாய்ப்பறவையொன்
றேறி வீற்றிருந்தா யுன்னை யென்னு ணீக்கே லெந்தாய்
en: After being changed [and] changed, being born in many births I reached servantship, [my] heart believing
I dived into a great flood of endless pleasure
O you who sit in distinction, mounted on the bird, pouncing, scattering all about
the many troupes of Asuras, don’t reject my heart, our father

ta: எந்தாய் தண்டிரு வேங்கடத்து ணின்றா யிலங்கை செற்றாய் மராமரம்
கொந்தார் தண்ணந் துழாயினா யமுதே யுன்னை யென்னுள்ளே குழைத்தவெம்
en: Our father, you who stand on cool, sacred Vēṅkaṭam, you who destroyed Laṅka, bowman
who strung a shapely arrow [against] seven green trunks of the Cadamba trees
you with cool Tulsi full of flower clusters, ambrosia, young man of us who mixed you
into my heart, bull of heaven, where is there to go now?
gloss: participial noun, singular, second person, perfective aspect
participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person
neuter singular, present tense, verbal noun

ta: போகின்ற காலங்கள் போய காலங்கள் போகு காலங்க டாய்தந் தையுயி
பாகின்ற தொல்புகழ் மூவுலகுக்கு நாதனே பரமா தண்வேங்கட
en: You who have become father, mother, life for the times that are going, the times that went
[and] the times that will go, I have reached you. Will I let go [of you]
leader of the three worlds with ancient fame that is distributed, Highest one, you who dwell
on cool Vēṅkaṭam, you with a chaplet fragrant with the scent of cool Tulsi?
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, vocative, third person
participial noun, present tense, singular, second person

ta: கண்ணித் தண்ணந் துழாய் முடிக்கமலத் தடம்பெருங் கண்ணனைப்புகழ்
வெண்ணில் சோர்வி ல்ந்தாதி யாயிரத்து ளிவையு மோர்பத் திசையோடும்
en: Those capable of singing in service
together with music these one ten among the thousand of countless, flawless Antāti
spoken by Caṭakōpaṉ Māṟaṉ of southern Kurukūr, reaching fame
on Kṛṣṇa with broad big lotus eyes [and] a crown of cool Tulsi in a chaplet
will be Keśava’s people

ta: வீச னென்கரு மாணிக்கமென் செங்கோலக் கண்ணன் விண்ணோர்
en: Our people will through seven births before [and] after be Keśava’s people
as our lives will flourish, having obtained this which is a great blessing
through the lord, my black ruby, my Kṛṣṇa of red beauty, the leader
of the celestials, our lord, our father, Nārāyaṇa
Nārāyaṇa, the leader of the whole seven worlds, the one who consists of Vedas
the one who is the first of causes, actions [and] karmas(?), our father
the lord who broke the elephant’s tusk, standing while the excellent awesome immortals
and many others worship [and] praise [him], is my Mādava
The ambrosia who destroys all evil
having taken in [my] saying “o Mādava”, having entered into me [and] staying
with the words “this share has now fallen to me. I won’t betray any invitations”
a hill with red lotus eyes
is my sugarcane candy without any fault, out lord, my Govinda
gloss: verbal noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect
participial noun, perfective aspect, neuter singular

en: When [I] kept [and] saying “Govinda, pot dancer, cowherd”, bending
singing the god [and] dancing, he perfected [and] took me
discarding my sins so that they were scattered, [and] made me of [his] nature that will be attached
to our people through seven [times] seven births, the strong one, our lord, Viṣṇu
Bright-shining red radiant lotuses are the feet, hand [and] eyes
a bright-shining dark glowing mountain the sacred body
of the excellence of the bright-shining moon the conch [and] discus
bright-shinig [like] the sun the crown of him, the lord, Madhusūdana
Standing aeon after aeon while [I] danced [and] sang songs that intented praise
without any(?) action, saying “I am without any other than Madhusūdana”
entering future incarnations while [he] did graces to me through one entire birth
if it it for me (eṉakkēl?), there is considering the father Trivikrama as [my] fate
gloss: neuter singular, perfective aspect, verbal noun

ta: திரிவிக் கிரமன் செந்தா மரைக்கணெம் மானென் செங்கனிவா
யுருவில் பொலிந்த வெள்ளை பளிங்குநிறத்தன னென்றென் றுள்ளிப்
பரவி பணிந்து பல்லூழி யூழிநின் பாத பங்கயமே
en: You who gave the mind that worships, joining
the lotuses [that are] your feet in many, many aeons, humbling itself, revering
thinking [of you], saying [and] saying “Trivikrama, our lord with red lotus eyes
my formless, flourishing, white crystal-coloured one with a red fruit mouth
you are strong, see, my Vāmana
gloss: participial noun, singular, second person, perfective aspect

ta: தூமனத் தனனாய்ப் பிறவித் துழதி நீங்க வென்னைத்
en: You who destroyed the evil in my mind so that the sorrow of birth left [me]
I being of pure mind, humbling myself at your ankleted [feet]
saying [and] saying “Vāman, my emerald-coloured one, lotus-eyed one
you who begot Kāma” what can I do for you, my bearer of Śrī?
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person
participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person

en: Establishing yourself day after day so that pleasure grew, so that the evil karma died
that had joined me, sighing [and] sighing hotly, tears increasing in [my] eyes, being confused, frightened
by night and day, saying [and] saying “o bearer of Śrī, o Kṛṣṇa with red lotus eyes”
you placed yourself in my heart, my Riṣikeśa
If you understand, o heart, saying [and] saying “Riṣikeśa, our lord, lord
who ended the obstinacy of the Rakṣasa clan of Lankā, our lord, lord of the immortals”
bow, know firmness. Knowing
even if you are confused, don’t let go, see Nampi, the one with a lotus in his navel
gloss: concessive, conditional, subjunctive, singular, second person

en: He in whose navel is a lotus, the powerful one who is high beyond height
my Highest one, wishfulfilling tree who made me for himself [and] gave himself
just to me, my ambrosia, the man from the good mountain of Vēṅkaṭam
who resembles a rain cloud, the lord of the celestials, [is] our father, Tamōtaraṉ
Those who worship saying “is it possible for anyone to know the greatness(?)
of Tāmotara, the solitary first one, the one who swallowed the world?”
is it possible even for Śiva and the one with faces in the directions, who are the form
of Tāmotara, to know the greatness(?) of our lord, my ocean-coloured one?
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, accusative, third person
participial noun, masculine singular, accusative, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, dative, honorific, third person, dative, third person
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

en: The song of twelve names in service
with these twelve among the thousand in the Tamil garland prepared
by Caṭakōpaṉ from southern Kurukūr on Neṭumāl, Kṛṣṇa
the head man of the immortals, the coloured dark sapphire light
will bring one close to the majesty’s feet
[He?] touches the chest of the flower girl on the serpent bed
[He?] unites with the Two, and he is the first of them
He is one in a pair. [He] is the root of liberation for everything
He is the rafter for those who swim the sea of birth
gloss: neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun
verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect
participial noun, dative, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: It is the root of liberation that is without misery to be swum
all other things, including birth that is a misery to be swum
the union with my solitary master with cool Tulsi in bloom
who chased away the affliction of the elephant in the flowering, cool, flooding pond
There is Aja who creates [and] Hara who destroys
staying in his navel from where he created [them]
He brings together the great union of sense organs everywhere
as she joins on his chest as Lakṣmī whom he brought together
Leaving the five sense organs on which graze the five senses
[and] enter the land of those who are without end in goodness
Without stopping settle in the primal excellence of the power
of the one who destroyed the Asuras so that they perished in confusion
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: The guardian of the three worlds, being the unaging solitary base
of all other things including birth with undending misery
who is animal, tortoise, fish [and] human
the great man, the god beyond gods is my saviour
Is it possible for someone again to speak
of the greatness of the one with fresh Tulsi who stopped being understood by the one who looked on
seeing for himself on Śiva’s crown the flower strands
he had joined to the red feet that had measured the world of the saviour
gloss: participial noun, neuter plural, perfective aspect
participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect

en: He will lie, sit, stand [on her], measure [her], enter below as a boar
he will dig [her] up he will hide [her] in himself, he will spit [her] out:
Who will see Māl who desired the lady
called “earth” whose big shoulders he fully embraced?
Who are those that will see my lord? Which way is there to see Kṛṣṇa?
If speaking of food, one rice [grain] will not assuage all the world
Is there liberation or life for those whose fate it is to be distant? For everything
he who does not slip from the eight parts spreads [and] is everywhere
It is famous, when examined, the greatness of my lion lord
who, when, angry with the son who said “Kṛṣṇa is everywhere”
Hiraṇya, beat the pillar, saying “[he] is not here!”
appeared so that he perished there and then
I have seen Kṛṣṇa, the one with a colour like rain clouds
who stands alone, spreading, being famous liberation, heaven
[and] finally hell, being in the middle of the affectionate gods
being the seed, being the root cause for everything else
Those who master these ten in the Tamil thousand spoken within the range of the melodies
by the man from the prosperous land of Vaḻuti with groves where bees hum
on the lord with a black body red in the eye area
will sit in distinction in the area of heaven [and] rule our great liberation
We won’t talk about our great liberation
Consent to [our] joining [our] head to your great red feet lotuses
o lord who chased away the distress of the hand-animal (~ elephant)
O father, I, [your] servant, need this
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

en: This is me taking you forever, my
effulgent sapphire-coloured one that touches on kajal [colour], our father
Help [me] to knowledge so that I reach your ankleted feet
which I have not [yet] reached, making the time pass
gloss: verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

en: He graces me with saying “don’t do evil deeds”
the lord Kṛṣṇa with a discus that fills [his] hand
Even if I get a throat full of phlegm, without reaching
your ankleted [feet], graciously make me praise [you]
Saying “be my servant at all times”, coming
to my mind, staying without vacating the place
he takes me to be just his. This
is the exultation I take [to be] Kṛṣṇa for me
In exultation let me reach liberation, heaven; hell
in death let me not reach, and I
when born, in many births I will always rejoice
without any forgetfulness, in the great lord
O father whose joyful light blooms
in the joyful gods, [this] world [and] the immaterial world
come so that [we] bow to you in joy
always with joyful thoughts, words [and] acts
Come, you who do do not give [me] a way to come close
without separating under you sacred foot blossoms
you who, if I put you into my heart always
do not satiate me always at any time
gloss: participial noun, negative, singular, second person
participial noun, negative, singular, second person

en: Any time you stay in my heart as my father
during all that time I won’t need anything
from you, my sweet ripe fruit
which the flawless ones who excell in the Vedas swallow
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: I, I could not know myself
Thinking “I am mine only” I was
I am you, and my possession is you alone
o our bull of the celestials who is praised in heaven
If I believe in the long glowing light that vanquished the seven opposing bulls
[and] made into ashes only beautiful Laṅka
consent in joining me to your golden feet
Don’t ever let go [of me] to go elsewhere
The ten in the indestructable thousand
among the words of Caṭakōpaṉ from liberal Kurukūr that do not let go
of being attached to the majesty with the flawless discus
make indestructable liberation to those who utter [them]
gloss: participial noun, dative, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: Before shining bright youth gets lost
it is a blessing to approach, as ones without faintness
Māliruñcōlai, surrounded by growing young groves
the temple that is joined by the growing bright Dark one
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect, oblique
neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

en: Without thinking of the lowliness of lovely young women
there is benefit in rising in praise of the lord
of Māliruñcōlai, whose summit is crawled over by the moon
the temple of the beautiful one with the thunder-voiced conch
Doing good for benefit is no benefit, heart
Reaching the mountain in the neighbourhood
of Māliruñcōlai surrounded by pleasure groves
the temple where desirously stays the one the colour of rain clouds
that is [good] action/karma
gloss: verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

en: For escaping with effort after removing the strong sling of karma
that way reaching that, [namely] the sacred mountain
of Māliruñcōlai where the coming clouds creep up
to the temple where dwells the might of him who lifted the big mountain
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

en: Without increasing the fiery karma with firm strength
the way is going to approach the outer mountain
of Māliruñcōlai surrounded by flawless generous mountain pools
the temple of him with the discus weapon who strives for justice
Think [that is] the way without committing lowly acts
Goodness is thinking of that correctly
Māliruñcōlai joined by does with fawns
the temple of him who ate the butter that was in the pot net
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

en: Think [it is] good without sinking into hell
Strength is to come together reaching the seat of strength
in Māliruñcōlai joined by the spotless moon
the temple, the lasting seat of him who once scooped up the earth
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: Acting with strength strength does not pass by day
The custom is to come together daily, acting with strength
in Māliruñcōlai of the celestials who act with strength
the temple of the wondrous trickster who acts with strength
Think [this is] the custom with sinking into cruel deeds/karma
The means(?) is being determined to be intent on worship
in Māliruñcōlai joined by herds of young elephant bulls
the great temple where abides he who killed the demoness
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun
neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

en: Without committing theft and gambling, thinking [them] means
wealth is entering the mountain where buds open
Māliruñcōlai joined by beautiful peacocks
the temple that is desired by him who once expounded the Veda
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect
neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

en: This decade among the one thousand spoken clearly
by generous Caṭakōpaṉ from unconfused, liberal Kurukūr
on the praise of him who created this world as matter
finally brings one close to the feet of him who possesses grace
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

en: Does the light of your face bloom as the light of a crown?
Does the light of [your] feet bloom as a lotus on which you stand?
Does your fresh golden protective light mingle
as many ornaments with your bright body garment? Tell [me]!
If you tell, lotuses are not equal to your eyes, feet [and] hands
Good gold that is heated [and] tested is not equal to the light of your luminous/sacred body
Speaking about suitability, all the great share of all the praise to you in this world
occurs [and] shows itseld pale as word [against your] highest light
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect, ideophone

en: You with highest light being the highest, in the absence of any other
highest light after, belittling you, I cannot speak you [your] quality
o Govinda, our highest light, who created the spreading world
inside yourself with highest light that stops [and] shine on the earth
Even though the great world of blooming area is unable
you gave thought to many creeds that are unable
to put the mind on the form of Śrī who resembles a blossom that is on you
You put [your] mind on the blooming Tulsi. The great world won’t suffer
Being a glowing body of blooming rays, of a difficult penance, that does not suffer
being knowledge that does not suffer, being made of the whole without boundaries
being the future time, the present time, the past time, being care
for the world as one how shall I exhaustively recite [your] qualities?
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect

en: Being all the reciters’ recitations, every and any thing in any world
good, there is nothing but the fitness of your praise
You with a crown of field Tulsi in which buds live, you with a chest
on which the woman on the flower lives, saying what shall I praise you?
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: While there are many who praise [you], in your mind your created
the four-faced one first, telling [him] “create the world [and] the water that engulfs [it]!”
If the immortals with Hara of lustrous excellence as the first emerge as bright gods
[and] praise [you] all around, will not your ancient fame absorb the stains?
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: Being a glowing body that does not absorb stains, being knowledge that does not absorb stains
not blossoming, not piling, being the whole, being made of the whole
if the king of the immortals praises [your] heavenly beauty that does not absorb stains
the light of the foot blossoms of you who does not absorb stains will not become dull
gloss: pronoun, singular, genitive, plural, second person

en: With the discus in [your] sharp nails that do not become blunt you appeared
mounted on the bird in order to provide for the loving elephant who worshipped [you] as good treasure
If you provide for those in [your] service in the blooming world
with knowledge that does not become blunt as a weapon, your glowing light will not vanish
gloss: participial noun, dative, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: O blooming light that stands in the four Vedas that were secret
you who in turn created, scooped up, swallowed, ejected [and] measured all this world
while the one with the crescent moon, bull [nd] matted hair, the four-faced one and Indra
praise [know], knowing that you are the lord, [your] sitting in distinction, is this a wonder?
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

en: These ten among the thousand that were composed, worshipping without fatigue
by Caṭakōpaṉ of Kurukūr with tanks where many live that are amply full of praise
on the Vedic one with true knowledge who is a wonder, who is without wonder
will cut off [re]birth, taking to liberation, in the world [surrounded by] the roaring three-watered [sea]
O our cloud-coloured one who created the world [surrounded by] the three-watered [sea]
I wander [my] way in the body you gave [me] that day
Which day shall I now come [and] join you, making a leap
so that karma is cut off an the root, so that the pain of cruel days perishes?
O our dwarf who measured the strong big world
I who am settled in many births [due] to you many great illusionary powers
cutting the root of [my] links with ancient, great, strong karma
which day will I stand joined to your dark/great feet?
gloss: neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

en: O our father who, commiting murder with a stick of a horse that did not kill
extinguished on the big ground the whole army of the Bhārata war
without stopping to cut of the links to [my] wicked body
give [me] unique counsel about my joining you
gloss: verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

en: O our father who pervades everywhere without loss in rising
always being the glowing light of counsel [and] knowledge
come [and] grace [me] with a manner of joining life
under the pair of your feet, refraining from any other subservience
Although coming it is like you don’t come. Act you so that
my mind is not scattered. If this is this only
o our father with the luminous colour of the rich blosoom of the ironwood tree
full of clusters, when shall I come [and] reach you?
I did not say “I can, I cannot”. I ended up parting after
tasting those: trifling saps through the former days
O Highest on who made many many thousand lives
at which time will there be my reaching you good golden-light feet?
gloss: neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

en: We, forever existing [and] existing, lamenting, o heart
without true knowledge, being pressed into birth of karmic nature
shall be attached to Kṛṣṇa, the light of true knowledge
who stands endlessly full every time and everywhere
I am without getting rid of the miserable karmas that are attached [to me]
and I am without bowing to your anklet[ed feet] without stopping
O Kṛṣṇa of pervasive ancient excellence, my highest glow
I call. How shall I call to reach [you] in order so see you?
gloss: neuter singular, perfective aspect, verbal noun

en: Calling, calling, standing inside the thicket of cruel karma
I, a sinner, perplexed about the way I am agitated
Where shall I meet now the father who extended
over the whole world, the one who guarded the cow herd that day with affection
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: So that, at the time of meeting, if Yama lets go of the snare on his people
all that unhappiness departs that eats [my] troubled flesh
having obtained a position by seeing for myself my Kṛṣṇa with the knowledge
of many arts, my heart has obtained long life
These ten among the thousand in the flawless musical world garland
of Caṭakōpaṉ from southern Kurukūr with groves that have coels
on the one who possesses all the worlds with the living being
further puts an end to the souls’ bodies in the flesh
Staying, being together all the time without end
we will want do faultless service
on sacred Vēṅkaṭam with waterfalls with resounding voices
to the father of the father of our father with beautiful light
O the majesty with raincloud-beauty of endless fame
on Vēṅkaṭam where rejoice in strewing flowers
the former celestials and the king of celestials
to the father of the father of the father of the father of our father
The majesty, the trickster, Kṛṣṇa with decorated red lotus
eyes, the black ruby with a a red fruit mouth
is the lord of the celestials, of countless ancient fame
on sacred Vēṅkaṭam with the water of clear full mountain pools
If you say “he is called the lord of the celestials”, is that
the land of him from sacred Vēṅkaṭam?
I am a low person, I have not a single accomplishment
for the highest glowing light that has placed a snare on me
If you call him the primordial form
whom all the worlds worship as light, is it [his] measure
the one from sacred Vēṅkaṭam of flawless excellence
the ambrosia of the whole Veda of the Veda experts?
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, accusative, third person

en: Burning sins, even though the former karma of the body is finished
they will make them good for themselves
Paying obeissance to those who stay in Vēṅkaṭam
that is the duty of those who are burdened
gloss: participial noun, honorific, third person, dative, imperfective aspect
participial noun, dative, perfective aspect, plural, honorific, third person

en: Sacred Vēṅkaṭam where suitably rise in obeissance
the celestials and the king of the celestials
laden with big flowers, water, lamps [and] incense
is the broad hill that gives peaceful liberation to us
The one who protected against the cool rain by holding up the mountain
the lord who measured the world that day, the Highest one
when we go, join [and] worship his sacred great Vēṅkaṭam mountain
as the only one our karma will come to an end
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: Old age, birth, dying [and] sickness will come to an end
for those who place in [their] mouths and in [their] minds
the foot lotuses that are day-[fresh] blossoms of the cowherd
from sacred Vēṅkaṭam, the one who makes a way [for them] to perish
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, imperfective aspect
participial noun, dative, imperfective aspect, plural, honorific, third person

en: Before being completely exhausted by going, nearing the border
of the mountain on the set day approach, please
those who sink into the flower tank swarmed by swarmed groves
of sacred Vēṅkaṭam of the one of a hooded serpent bed
gloss: neuter singular, imperfective aspect, oblique, verbal noun
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person
participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: Those who master these ten in the matchless thousand
spoken by Caṭakōpaṉ of Kuṟukūr with long groves
on the lord who spanned the earth, expanding [his] foot
will live, reaching life while the world praises

ta: புகழுநல் லொருவ னென்கோ பொருவில்சீர்ப் பூமி யென்கோ
திகழுந்தண் பரவை யென்கோ தீயென்கோ வாயு வென்கோ
நிகழுமா காச மென்கோ நீள்சுட ரிரண்டு மென்கோ
விகழ்விலிவ் வனைத்து மென்கோ கண்ணனைக் கூவு மாறே
en: Will I say “the one good one who is praised“? Will I say “earth of incomparable excellence”?
Will I say “glittering cool expanse“ ? Will I say “fire”? Will I say “wind”?
Will I say “floating room”? Will I say “two long lights”?
Will I say all these things without negligence, the way I call Kṛṣṇa?

ta: கூவுமா றறிய மாட்டேன் குன்றங்க ளனைத்து மென்கோ
மேவுசீர் மாரி யென்கோ விளங்குதா ரகைக ளென்கோ
நாவியல் கலைக ளென்கோ ஞானநல் லாவி யென்கோ
பாவுசீர்க் கண்ண னெம்மான் பங்கயக் கண்ண னையே
en: I don’t know the way to call [him]: Will I say “all the hills”?
Will I say “showers of lasting excellence”? Will I say “shining stars”?
Will I say “arts the nature of the tongue”? Will I say “good soul of knowledge”?
Kṛṣṇa of wide-spread fame, our lord, the one with lotus eyes

ta: பங்கயக் கண்ண னென்கோ பவளச்செவ் வாய னென்கோ
வங்கதி ரடிய னென்கோ வஞ்சன வண்ண னென்கோ
செங்கதிர் முடிய னென்கோ திருமறு மார்ப னென்கோ
சங்குசக் கரத்த னென்கோ சாதிமா ணிக்கத் தையே
en: Will I say “the one with lotus eyes”? Will I say “he with a coral-red mouth”?
Will I say “he with pretty-rayed feet”? Will I say “he with kajal colour”?
Will I say “he with a red-rayed crown” Will I say “he with Śrī as a stain on his chest”
Will I say “he with conch and discus”? to the ruby by kind
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

ta: சாதிமா ணிக்க மென்கோ சவிகோள்பொன் முத்த மென்கோ
சாதிநல் வயிர மென்கோ தவிவில்சீர் விளக்க மென்கோ
வாதியஞ் சோதி யென்கோ வாதியம் புருட னென்கோ
வாதுமில் காலத் தெந்தை யச்சுத னமல னையே
en: Will I say “ruby by kind”? Will I say “splendid gold [and] pearls”?
Will I say “good diamond by kind”? Will I say “lamp of unceasing excellence”?
Will I say “primordial light”? Will I say “primordial man”?
to our father in a time without all that, to the unshakable one, the spotless one

ta: அச்சுத னமல னென்கோ வடியவர் வினைகெ டுக்கு
நச்சுமா மருந்த மென்கோ நலங்கட லமுத மென்கோ
வச்சுவைக் கட்டி யென்கோ வறுசுவை யடிசி லென்கோ
நெய்ச்சுவைத் தேற லென்கோ கனியென்கோ பாலென் கேனோ
en: Will I say “unshakable on, spotless one”? Will I say “desired great remedy
that destroys the devotees’ karma”? Will I say “ocean of goodness, ambrosia”?
Will I say “well-tasting sweets”? Will I say “rice with six tastes”?
Will I say “clarified sap with butter taste”? Will I say “ripe fruit”? do I say “milk”?
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

ta: பாலென்கோ நான்கு வேதப் பயனென்கோ சமய நீதி
நூலென்கோ நுடங்கு கேள்வி யிசையென்கோ விவற்று ணல்ல
மேலென்கோ வினையின் மிக்க பயனென்கோ கண்ண னென்கோ
மாலென்கோ மாய னென்கோ வானவ ராதி யையே
