en: Will I say “milk”? Will I say “benefit of the Veda”? Will I say “treatise
of dogmatic rules”? Will I say “music of swaying sound”? Will I say “goodness on top
in these”? Will I say “abundant fruit of karma”? Will I say “Kṛṣṇa”?
Will I say “Māl”? Will I say “trickster”? to the first of the celestials

ta: வானவ ராதி யென்கோ வானவர் தெய்வ மென்கோ
வானவர் போக மென்கோ வானவர் முற்று மென்கோ
வூனமில் செல்வ மென்கோ வூனமில் சுவர்க்க மென்கோ
வூனமின் மோக்க மென்கோ வொளிமணி வண்ண னையே
en: Will I say “first of the celestials”? Will I say “god the the celestials”?
Will I say “enjyoment of the celestials”? Will I say “the all of the celestials”?
Will I say “flawless wealth”? Will I say “flawless heaven”?
Will I say “flawless liberation”? to the one of bright sapphire colour
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, accusative, third person

ta: ஒளிமணி வண்ண னென்கோ வொருவனென் றேத்த நின்ற
நளிர்மதிச் சடைய னென்கோ நான்முகக் கடவு ளென்கோ
வளிமகிழ்ந் துலக மெல்லாம் படைத்தவை யேத்த நின்ற
களிமலர்த் துளவ னெம்மான் கண்ணனை மாய னையே
en: Will I say “the one of bright sapphire colour”? Will I say “he in whose matted hair is the cool moon
who stands as they praise [him] as one”? Will I say “the four-facted god”?
to him with nectar-blossom tulsi, lord, Kṛṣṇa, the trickster
who stands while while they praise [him] for all the worlds he created, rejoicing in [his] care
gloss: participial noun, neuter plural, perfective aspect

ta: கண்ணனை மாயன் றன்னைக் கடல்கடைந் தமுதங் கொண்ட
வண்ணலை யச்சு தன்னை யனந்தனை யனந்தன் றன்மே
னண்ணிநன் குறைகின் றானை ஞாலமுண் டுமிழ்ந்த மாலை
யெண்ணுமா றறிய மாட்டேன் யாவையும் யவருந் தானே
en: Kṛṣṇa, the trickster, the majesty who churned the ocean [and] took
the ambrosia, the unshakable one, the unending one, the one who rests
well, staying on Ananta, Māl who swallowed [and] spir out the world
I don’t know a way to account for him. He is everthing and everyone
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, accusative, present tense

ta: யாவையும் யவருந் தானா யவரவர் சமயந் தோறுந்
தோய்விலன் புலனைந் துக்குஞ் சொலப்படா னுணர்வின் மூர்த்தி
யாவிசே ருயிரி னுள்ளா லாதுமோர் பற்றி லாத
பாவனை யதனைக் கூடி லவனையுங் கூட லாமே
en: Being everything and everyone, all those people in all the creeds
the one without touch, the one not spoken about when shedding the five senses, the form of perception
the imagination that exists without any support of all that by the inside of the breath
that joins the soul, if you join that, it is possible to join with him

ta: கூடிவண் டறையுந் தண்தார்க் கொண்டல்போல் வண்ணன் றன்னை
மாடலர் பொழில்கு ருகூர் வண்சட கோபன் சொன்ன
வீடில போக மெய்தி விரும்புவ ரமரர் மொய்த்தே
en: Those who master this one decade in the one thousand songs
spoken by liberal Caṭakōpaṉ from Kurukūr with rich-blooming groves
on the one with a colour like the clouds with a cool garland where bees join [and] hum
reaching enjoyment without loss the immortals will swarm around [and] desire [them]

ta: மொய்ம்மாம் பூம்பொழில் பொய்கை முதலைச் சிறைப்பட்டு நின்ற
கைம்மாவுக் கருள் செய்த கார்முகில் போல்வண்ணன் கண்ண
னெம்மா னைச்சொல்லிப் பாடி யெழுந்தும் பறந்துந் துள்ளாதார்
தம்மால் கருமமென் சொல்லீர் தண்கடல் வட்டத்துள் ளீரே
en: Kṛṣṇa, the one with a colour like a rain cloud who did grace to the hand animal
that stood held captive by the crocodile in the pond with [bee-]swarmed mango flower groves
those who don’t frolic, rising and spreading in song, speaking about our lord
the deeds [done] by them are what, say, you who are in the circle [surrounded] by the cool sea?
gloss: participial noun, negative, honorific, third person

ta: தண்கடல் வட்டத் துள்ளாரைத் தமக்கிரை யாத்தடிந் துண்ணுந்
திண்கழற் காலசு ரர்க்குத் தீங்கிழைக் குந்திரு மாலை
பண்க டலைக்கொள்ளப் பாடிப் பறந்துங் குனித்து முழலாதார்
மண்கொ ளுலகிற் பிறப்பார் வல்வினை மோத மலைந்தே
en: Tirumāl who does harm to the Asuras with firm anklets on [their] feet
who cut [and] eat as their food those who are in the circle [surrounded] by the cool sea
those who don’t roam, spreading and bowing in song on him, as the melodies take hold [of them]
they will be [re]born in the earth world, begin opposed as [their] harsh karma strikes
gloss: participial noun, accusative, honorific, third person

ta: மலையை யெடுத்துக்கன் மாரி காத்துப் பசுநிரை தன்னைத்
தொலைவு தவிர்த்த பிரானைச் சொல்லிச்சொல் லிநின்றெப் போதுந்
தலையினோ டாதனந் தட்டத் தடுகுட்ட மாய்ப்பற வாதா
ரலைகொ ணரகத் தழுந்திக் கிடந்துழைக் கின்ற வம்பரே
en: Standing [and] talking [and] talking all the time about the lord who averted the loss
of the cow herd by lifting the mountain [and] guarding [it] against the stone rain
those who don’t move as a Taṭukuṭṭam dance that is agreeable in posture to the head
they are vile people who sink into harassing hell, lie [and] toil
gloss: participial noun, negative, honorific, third person

ta: வம்பவிழ் கோதை பொருட்டா மால்விடை யேழு மடர்த்த
செம்பவ ளத்திரள் வாயன் சிரீதரன் தொல்புகழ் பாடிக்
கும்பிடு நட்டமிட் டாடிக் கோகுகட் டுண்டுழ லாதார்
தம்பிறப் பால்பய னென்னே சாது சனங்க ளிடையே
en: Those who do not roam, absorbing ???, dancing by putting a dance with folded hands
singing the ancient fame of Śrīdhara, the one with a round red coral mouth
who killed seven big bulls for the sake of [the one with] the freshly opening garland
what benefit by their birth among good folk?
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person
participial noun, negative, honorific, third person

ta: சாது சனத்தை நலியுங் கஞ்சனைச் சாதிப்ப தற்
காதியஞ் சோதி யுருவை யங்குவைத் திங்குப் பிறந்த
வேத முதல்வனைப் பாடி வீதிகள் தோறுந் துள்ளாதா
ரோதி யுணர்ந்தவர் முன்னா வென்சவிப் பார்ம னிசரே
en: Those who do not frolic in every street, singing the first one of the Vedas
who was born here, putting [his] pretty primordial form of light there
in order to destroy Kamsa who afflicts good folk
without approaching those who recite [and] perceive, what will humans pray?
gloss: neuter singular, dative, imperfective aspect, verbal noun
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, accusative, third person
participial noun, honorific, third person, perfective aspect

ta: மனிசரு மற்று முற்றுமாய் மாயப் பிறவி பிறந்த
தனியன் பிறப்பிலி தன்னைத் தடங்கடல் சேர்ந்த பிரானைக்
கனியைக் கரும்பினின் சாற்றைக் கட்டியைத் தேனை யமுதை
முனிவின்றி யேத்திக் குனிப்பார் முழுதுணர் நீர்மை யினாரே
en: The solitary one who took miraculous births as humans, others
and everything, the one without birth, the lord who joined the vast icean
the ripe fruit, the sweet sap of sugarcan, the sweetmeat, the honey
those who bow endlessly praising him are of the nature to understand all
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

ta: நீர்மையி னூற்றுவர் வீய வைவர்க் கருள்செய்து நின்று
பார்மல்கு சேனை யவித்த பரஞ்சுட ரைநினைந் தாடி
நீர்மல்கு கண்ணின ராகி நெஞ்சங் குழைந்து நையாதே
யூன்மல்கி மோடு பருப்பா ருத்தமர் கட்கென் செய்வாரே
en: Those whose bellies become large, abounding in flesh
without dancing, thinking of the highest glow who put an end to the army abounding on earth
standing while gracing the Five so that the conductless Hundred were destroyed
without that water abounds in their eyes, without melting [and] languishing in the heart
what [good] will they do to the highest ones?
gloss: pronominalised noun, dative, honorific, third person
participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person
pronominalised noun, plural, dative, honorific, third person

ta: வார்புன லந்தண் ணருவி வடதிரு வேங்கடத் தெந்தை
பேர்பல சொல்லிப் பிதற்றிப் பித்த ரென்றே பிறர்கூற
வூர்பல புக்கும் புகாது முலோகர் சிரிக்க நின்றாடி
யார்வம் பெருகிக் குனிப்பா ரமரர் தொழப்படு வாரே
en: Those who chatter, saying many names of our father in sacred northern Vēṅkaṭam
with pretty cool waterfalls with overflowing floods, while others just say “madmen”
entering and not entering many villages while those of the world laugh, who constantly dance
[and] bow, affection increasing, they will be worshipped by the immortals
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

ta: அமரர் தொழப்படு வானை யனைத்துல குக்கும் பிரானை
யமரர் மனத்தினுள் யோகு புணர்ந்தவன் றன்னோ டொன்றாக
வமரத் துணியவல் லார்க ளொழியவல் லாதவ ரெல்லா
மமர நினைந்தெழுந் தாடி யலற்றுவ தேகரு மம்மே
en: Except for those capable of suitably resolving to be one with him
joining the yoga in the mind of the immortals on the lord of the whole world
the one who is praised by the immortals, of all the others besides
suitably thinking, rising, dancing and babbling is the only action
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, singular, masculine, accusative

ta: கருமமுங் கரும பலனு மாகிய காரணன் றன்னைத்
திருமணி வண்ணனைச் செங்கண் மாலினைத் தேவ பிரானை
யொருமை மனத்தி னுள்வைத் துள்ளங் குழைந்தெழுந் தாடிப்
பெருமையு நாணுந் தவிர்ந்து பிதற்றுமின் பேதைமை தீர்ந்தே
en: The cause who is karma and the fruit of karma
the one of luminous sapphire colour, red-eyed Māl, the godly lord
placing him in oneness in [your] minds, [your] hearts melting, rising, dancing
refraining from loftiness and shame babble, folly ending
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

ta: தீர்ந்த வடியவர் தம்மைத் திருத்திப் பணிகொள்ள வல்ல
வார்ந்த புகழச் சுதனை யமரர் பிரானை யெம்மானை
வாய்ந்த வளவயல் சூழ்தண் வளங்குரு கூர்ச்சட கோப
னேர்ந்தவோ ராயிரத் திப்பத்து மருவினை நீறு செய்யுமே
en: These ten in the one thousand granted
by Caṭakōpaṉ from cool fertile Kurukūr surrounded by excellent fertile fields
on our lord the lord of immortals, the unshakable one with fame that is full
who is capable of correcting the devotees who come to an end [and] take [them] in service
will make difficult karma into ashes

ta: செய்ய தாமரைக் கண்ண னாயுல கேழு முண்ட வவன்கண்டீர்
வையம் வான மனிசர் தெய்வ மற்று மற்று மற்று முற்றுமாய்
செய்ய சூழ்சுடர் ஞான மாய்வெளிப் பட்டி வைபடைத் தான்பின்னு
மொய்கொள் சோதியோ டாயி னானொரு மூவ ராகிய மூர்த்தியே
en: He who as red lotus-eyed Kṛṣṇa swallowed the seven worlds, see
becoming earth, sky, humans, gods and others and others and all
revealing himself as red pervasive glowing knowledge, he created these, and after
along with excellent light he became the form that is the one triad
gloss: singular, masculine, third person, perfective aspect

ta: மூவ ராகிய மூர்த்தி யைமுதன் மூவர்க் குமுதல் வன்றன்னைச்
சாவ முள்ளன நீக்கு வானைத் தடந்க டல்கிடந் தான்றன்னைத்
தேவ தேவனைத் தென்னி லங்கை யெரியெழச் செற்ற வில்லியைப்
பாவ நாசனைப் பங்க யத்தடங் கண்ண னைப்பர வுமினோ
en: The form that is the Three, the first one of the primeval Three
the one who repels those that are on the bow, the one who lies on the vast ocean
the god of gods, the bowman who destroyed southern Laṅka so it went up in flame
the destroyer of evil, Kṛṣṇa with broad lotus eyes rever
gloss: pronominalised noun, honorific, third person, dative

ta: பரவி வானவ ரேத்த நின்ற பரம னைபரஞ் சோதியைக்
குரவை கோத்த குழக னைமணி வண்ண னைக்குடக் கூத்தனை
யரவ மேறி யலைக டலம ருந்து யில்கொண்ட வண்ணலை
யிரவு நன்பக லும்விடா தென்று மேத்து தன்மனம் வைம்மினோ
en: The Highest one who stands while the celestials rever [and] praise [him], the highest light
the youth who strung the Kuravai, the saphhire-coloured one, the pot dancer
the majesty who took sleep that abides on the dashing sea mounted on a serpent
without leaving off be night and by good day always set [your] minds to praising
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

ta: வைம்மி னும்மனத் தென்று யானுரைக் கின்ற மாயவன் சீர்மையை
யெம்மனோர் களுரைப் பதென்னது நிற்க நாடொறும் வானவர்
தம்மை யாளு மவனு நான்முக னுஞ்ச டைமுடி யண்ணலுஞ்
செம்மை யாலவன் பாத பங்கயஞ் சிந்தித் தேத்தித் திரிவரே
en: What do the likes of us have to say about the excellence of the trickster about whom I say:
“put your minds [on him]”? Let that be [as may be]. Every day the one who rules
the celestials, the four-faced one and the majesty with a crown of matted hair
wander praising, thinking of the feet lotuses of him because of [his] superiority
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

ta: திரியுங் காற்றோ டகல்வி சும்பு திணிந்த மண்கிடந் தகட
லெரியுந் தீயோ டிருசு டர்தெய்வ மற்று மற்று முற்றுமாய்
கரிய மேனியன் செய்ய தாமரைக் கண்ணன் கண்ணன்விண் ணோரிறை
சுரியும் பல்கருங் குஞ்சி யெங்கள் சுடர்முடி யண்ண றோற்றமே
en: Being, along with the wandering wind, the wide sky, the firm earth, the lying sea
along with the flaming fire the two lights, the gods, other things and other things and all
is the appearance of our majesty with the glowing crown with much curly black hair
the lord of the celestials, Kṛṣṇa, the one with red lotus eyes, with a black body

ta: தோற்றக் கேடவை யில்ல வன்னுடை யான வனொரு மூர்த்தியாய்ச்
சீற்றத் தோடருள் பெற்ற வனடிக் கீழ்ப்பு கநின்ற செங்கண்மா
னாற்றந் தோற்றஞ் சுவையொ லியுற லாகி நின்றவெம் வானவ
ரேற்றை யேயன்றி மற்றொ ருவரை யானி லேனெழு மைக்குமே
en: The one without these: appearance [and] disappearance, the master, red-eyed Māl
who stood while the one who obtained [his] grace with anger entered below [his] feet, being his one form
our bull of the celestials who stood as smell, appearance, taste, sound [and] touch
apart from him I am without any other through seven births
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, accusative, honorific, third person

ta: எழுமைக் குமென தாவிக் கின்னமு தத்தி னையென தாருயிர்
கெழுமி யகதிர்ச் சோதி யைமணி வண்ண னைக்குடக் கூத்தனை
விழுமி யவம ரர்மு னிவர்வி ழுங்குங் கன்னல் கனியினைத்
தொழுமின் தூயம னத்த ராயிறை யுந்நில் லாதுய ரங்களே
en: The sweet ambrosia of my soul for seven births, my precious life
the full-rayed light, the one of sapphire-colour, the pot dancer
the sugarcane fruit that is swallowed by excellent immortals [and] sages
him worship, being pure of mind. [Your] affliction will not stay for a moment
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person
pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, accusative, third person

ta: துயர மேதரு துன்ப வின்ப வினைக ளாயவை யல்லனா
யுயர நின்றதோர் சோதியா யுலகே ழுமுண்டுமிழ்ந் தான்றன்னை
யயர வாங்கு நமன்ற மர்க்கரு நஞ்சி னையச் சுதன்றன்னைத்
தயர தற்கும கன்றன் னையன்றி மற்றி லேன்றஞ்ச மாகவே
en: Except for the one who, being without those, [namely] miserable [and] pleasant karmas that bring affliction
being a light that stands high, swallowed [and] spit out the seven worlds
the rare poison for Yama’s people who drag wearily, the Unshakable one
the son of Daśaratha I am withou other as a refuge
gloss: neuter singular, perfective aspect, relative, verbal noun
participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

ta: தஞ்ச மாகிய தந்தை தாயொடு தானு மாயவை யல்லனா
யெஞ்ச லிலம ரர்கு லமுதன் மூவர் தம்முள்ளு மாதியை
யஞ்சி நீருல கத்துள் ளீர்க ளவனி வனென்று கூழேன்மி
னெஞ்சி னானினைப் பான்ய வனவ னாகு நீள்கடல் வண்ணனே
en: The one who, being himself as father and mother who are refuge, being not those
is the first among the primeval Three in the family of flawless immortals
you who are in the world, afraid, don’t doubt “that one, this one”
Whichever one is thought about in the heart, that one becomes the one the colour of the long sea
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, imperfective aspect

ta: கடல்வண் ணன்கண்ணன் விண்ண வர்கரு மாணிக் கமென தாருயிர்
படவ ரவின ணைக்கி டந்த பரஞ்சு டர்பண்டு நூற்றுவ
ரடவ ரும்படை மங்க வைவர்கட் காகி வெஞ்சமத் தன்றுதேர்
கடவி யபெரு மான்க னைகழல் காண்ப தென்றுகொல் கண்களே
en: The ocean-coloured one, Kṛṣṇa, the black ruby of the celestials, my precious life
the highest glow who lies on a hooded serpent bed, the great man who drove the chariot
that day in hot battle for the sake of the Five when [their] army diminished that came
so that the Hundred would die formerly, when will [my] eyes see his tinkling anklets?
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person
neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

ta: கண்கள் காண்டற் கரிய னாய்க்கருத் துக்கு நன்றுமெ ளியனாய்
மண்கொண் ஞாலத்து யிர்க்கெல் லாமருள் செய்யும் வானவ ரீசனைப்
பண்கொள் சோலை வழுதி வளநாடன் குருகைக் கோன்சட கோபன்சொல்
பண்கொ ளாயிரத் திப்பத் தால்பத்த ராகக் கூடும் பயிலுமினே
en: With these ten in the melodious thousand
spoken by Caṭakōpaṉ, the king of Kurukai, man from the fertile land of Vaḻuti with serviceable groves
on the lord of the celestials who grants grace to all living being in the earth world
being difficult to see for the eyes, being well easy for the intention
join as devotees, praise
The form of dense glowing light, the lotus-eyed Kṛṣṇa
our Highest one who joined the densely sweet milk ocean for our sake
those who have the fortune to call [him], whoever they are, see
are the highest ones who rule us in every reccurrent birth
The Highest one who rules, Kṛṣṇa, the lord with the discus
the one the colour of a pure sapphire with once four arms, our lord
those who humble themselves before him, folding the feet and hands, see
are daily in every birth the leaders who have us as servants
The leader, the one with buds of fragrant Tulsi whom earth and heaven
praise, our father with the large golden discus, the lord
they who humble themselves before those capable of humbling themselves at his feet, see
possess us as servants in every birth we recite
gloss: pronominalised noun, accusative, honorific, third person
pronominalised noun, plural, honorific, third person

ta: னடையா வுடைத்திரு நாரணன் றொண்டர் தொண்டர் கண்டீ
en: He with a dress that is full of cloth(?), he with a necklace, he with a cloth thread
he with a golden string on [his] sides, he with a gold crown, he with many other ornaments
Śrī-possessing Nārāyaṇa the servants of the servants with him as [their] walk [of life], see
are out great people for us in every birth full of troubles(?)
Those, see, who rave about those capable of raving about the greatness
of the great lord of those who are among great people, the father who fed
the rare ambrosia that day so that the difficulties of the immortals ended
are the lords who take care of us in the coming birth and in this one
gloss: pronominalised noun, accusative, honorific, third person

en: Those, see, who take into [their] hearts the bright effulgence
the Highest one who takes care, Kṛṣṇa, the lord with the discus
our lord with the colour of the pure sapphire with a [nectar-]dripping fragrant chaplet
will without weariness rule [and] guard us in birth after birth
Those, see, who rave about those capable to rave about the ancientness
of the father who, guarding [them] birth after birth leads [his] servants
making [them] obtain [his] nature [and] takes them under his pair of feet
will be friends who make us obtain goodness [and] take us so that that we escape the days
gloss: pronominalised noun, accusative, honorific, third person

en: The Supreme one, the creator of the world, the one with Śrī on [his] chest
the one difficult to perceive for anyone in the world beyond
those, see, who praise him, even if they are from a hell of hot ashes
are the clan we worship in each of our many births
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, accusative, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, plural, honorific, third person

en: Those whose minds are absorbed [in the thought] “[we are] the servants
of the majesty with the victory-bearing discus, the one with sapphire colour”
even though they be Caṇḍālas of the Caṇḍālas without any goodness
that are low in the four castes that uphold the families
the servants of their servants [are] our lords/objects of veneration
gloss: participial noun, honorific, third person, perfective aspect

en: We are the servants of the servants of the servants of the servants
of the servants of the servants of the servants of the servants
of the lord our father on earth as a child without any equal
who takes a nap on the fig leaf after having swallowed the world full of feet
If able to learn up to the end
on his slaves these ten in the thousand filled with [metrical] lines
that are the services of Caṭakōpaṉ from southern Kurukūr on the Tall one
who did grace to the Five that day so that the Hundred high in origin perished
not being [re-]born will be accomplished
My heart reposes saying “you with the crown
you with the excellent foot that the three worlds worship [and] praise
you who churned the deep ocean, you with a banner mounted by the bird
you of cloud colour, Tall one beyond the egg[-shaped universe].”
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person
participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person

en: “My refuge where [my] heart sits while in the tall city
poisonous one who destroyed the lord of cool Laṅka
deceiver who became a dwarf in order to take the world”
[thus] says my speech all the time
O leader of the celestials who does grace while the speech praises
o the one who leapt over the cowherders who touched [and] ate
the milk [and] butter inside the bamboo, releasing the hold
on the day-young moon”, [thus] fumble my hands
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: Worshipping [and] worshipping you fully with [my] hands
daily and for the time of a moment, apart from a liberation
of Highest one who stays mounted on a hooded serpent
my eyes desire to truly see you
My ears repose [and] listen steadfastely
experiencing the sound of the wings of the serviceable bird
that goes joyfully while the dwarf who took the earth mounts [it]
with the longing “will he come [for me] to see with [my own] eyes?
Absorbing [it] fully with the ears when the poems that speak
of the fruit of your fame timely drip with melodious honey
apart from annihilation my soul craves
only for you with the golden large discus on earth
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person

en: Ambrosia of which [my] soul is full, you who, possessing me as a servant
possess a pretty feathered bird, you with the glowing discus
while the heart of me, a sinner, is lonely, although calling
many times I did not get to see your beauty
gloss: participial noun, singular, vocative, second person

en: O the beauty of the lotus eyes, o the unique kajal
colour, o the nature that stands [and] cuts my
soul, o the times that have gone, not gone [and] stand
before [me] which day shall I see you for myself?
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person

en: I take. O robber who said to Māvali “give [me]
three steps”, you who, having deceived Kamsa
cut off the one thousand arms of Bāṇa so that [his] inner strength ended
you who master the bird, when shall I join you?
O our paragon who went in between the united great Marutu trees
confusedly suffering in order to see your anklet
being [and] being there with a word garland
how many times will I lament you?
gloss: pronominalised noun, oblique, singular, second person

en: When speaking these ten among the powerful thousand
spoken by Caṭakōpaṉ of good, excellent, good Kurukūr
on the great lord who measured the earth of solitary excellence
everyone will rise to shining heaven
If I speak, even though it is controversial, I shall speak. Listen:
I cannot give the sweet poem on my tongue to anybody
that in sacred Vēṅkaṭam where bees hum “sssss”
he is my elephant, my father, my great lord
gloss: pronominalised noun, dative, honorific, third person

en: What of singing a poem on this humanity who thinks its wealth
to be riches, for it to be one, while thinking that he is
our father, except the great lord our father, that he is
in truth Kṛṣṇa in Kuṟuṅkuṭi sourrounded by paddy fields full of tanks
Taking very good divine poems, you poets, [only] to go [and] pass
while our lord stands, the lord of the celestials who gives the way
that goes to last for many aeons after aeons without any end
what is [the point] of lowly regarding [and] singing a [mere] humanity?
What is is [and] for how many tomorrows they great wealth you create
you poets, by always singing humans that do not last?
If you sing the father of the celestials with a crown of flashing jewels
he will take [you] to be his and will undertake [you] not making [further] birth
There is no benefit to take, you poets who lose your truth
in praising the liberality of wealth that shines up in heaps
Come to say a poem on the one of sapphire colour, my liberal man
without fault who gives all one wants, he who is without want to take
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect

en: Come, you poets. Escape by making your bodies suffer [and] woking with [your] hands
In this lasting world there are no rich people. We are people who have seen [that]
If you take your pleasing poems [and] praise the deity as the one chosen by each of you
it will reach my Tirumāl with a red flashing glowing crown
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, plural, first person

en: Except for the lord who possesses on thousand names
who is without boundary for the fame of giving when one joins him, I cannot
tell lies green with freshness about a low person on earth
saying “hands that resemble rain showers, firm shoulder similar to large mountain.”
I whose love it is to sing the bridegroom of Piṉṉai, she with shoulders
much resembling bamboo, for [his] existing great fame that is without bounds
to go, discard the body [and] enter under his pair of feet
how can I speak with my mouth about deceitful humans?
I am not a poet who came to sing humanity with [his] mouth
For me is the lord with the discus, the beautiful excellent liberal man
Having established this brilliant birth, lasting, lasting he will give [me]
liberation, saying “see for yourself the land of the celestials”
Counting, although going on, going [and] going, on leaving this body
that is sent lasting, lasting for many days, seeing [and] discarding birth
for me who is a poet of the one who created the world, being all one [with it]
is a poem on any other suitable, now and forever and ever?
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, third person, perfective aspect
participial noun, dative, perfective aspect, singular, first person

en: To those who master speaking the great fame that is suitable
of these ten among the thousand of great praise that is suitable
composed by Caṭakōpaṉ of liberal Kurukūr of great praise that is suitable
for Kṛṣṇa, the lord of the celestials of great fame that is suitable

ta: சன்மம் பலபல செய்து வெளிப்பட்டு சங்கொடு சக்கரம்வி
லொண்மை யுடைய வுலக்கையொள் வாடண்டு கொண்டுபுள் ளூர்ந்துலகில்
வன்மை யுடைய வரக்க ரசுரரை மாளப் படைபொருத
நன்மை யுடையவன் சீர்பர வப்பெற்ற நானோர் குறைவிலனே
en: I, who have obtained revering the excellence of him who possesses goodness
who fought with weapons the strong rakṣasas and asuras so they would perish
in the world, mounted on the bird, taking the discus along with the conch, the bow
a bright pestle, a bright sword [and] a staff, having come out making many many births
am without any want
gloss: accusative, honorific, third person, third person

ta: குறைவி றடங்கடல் கோள்ளர வேறித்தன் கோலச்செந் தாமரைக்கண்
உறைபவன் போலவோர் யோகுபுணர்ந்த வொளிமணி வண்ணன் கண்ணன்
கறையணி மூக்குடைப் புள்ளைக் கடாவி யசுரரைக் காய்ந்தவம்மான்
நிறைபுக ழேத்தியும் பாடியு மாடியும் யானொரு முட்டிலனே
en: The one who mounted the murderous serpent on the vast ocean without want, like the one who stays
with beatiful red lotus eyes, the one with bright sapphire colour who is joined in unique yoga, Kṛṣṇa
the lord who rages against the asuras, driving the bird with a spot-adorned nose
praising his] full fame, singing and dancing I am without any obstacle
gloss: pronominalised noun, masculine singular, perfective aspect
participial noun, masculine singular, imperfective aspect

ta: முட்டில் பல்போகத் தொருதனி நாயகன் மூவுல குக்குரிய
கட்டியைத் தேனை யமுதைநன் பாலைக் கனியைக் கரும்புதன்னை
மட்டவிழ் தண்ணந்து ழாய்முடி யானை வணங்கி யவன்றிறத்து
பட்ட பின் னையிறை யாகிலும் யானென் மனத்து பரிவிலனே
en: Although he is the lord I am without affliction in my mind, after I have fallen
for him, bowing to the one solitary leader of many enjoyments without obstacle
the sweetmeat that has the right to the three worlds, the honey, ambrosia, good milk, ripe fruit, sugarcane
the one with a crown of cool tulsi on which the nectar[-blossoms] open

ta: பரிவின்றி வாணனைக் காத்துமென் றன்று படையொடும் வந்தெதிர்ந்த
திரிபுரஞ் செற்றவ னுமக னும்பின்னு மங்கியும் போர்தொலையப்
பொருசிறைப் புள்ளைக் கடாவிய மாயனை யாயனைப் பொன்சக்கரத்
தரியினை யச்சுத னைப்பற்றி யானிறை யேனு மிடரிலனே
en: Although I am one who has a lord, holding on to the unshakable one, to Hari
with the golden discus, the cowherd, the trickster who drives the bird with beating wings
so that the one who destroyed the three cities and the son and after [them] Agni lost the battle
[he] who had come [and] faced [him] with a weapon thinking he would guard Bāṇa without affliction
I am without distress
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, accusative, second person

ta: இடரின்றி யேயொரு நாளொரு போழ்திலெல் லாவல குங்கழியப்
படர்புகழ் பார்த்தனும் வைதிக னுமுட னேறத்திண் டேர்கடவிச்
சுடரொளி யாய்நின்ற தன்னுடைச் சோதியில் வைதிகன் பிள்ளைகளை
யுடலொடுங் கொண்டுகொடுத் தவனைப் பற்றி யொன்றுந் துயரிலனே
en: Holding on to the one who gave, taking [them] along with [their] bodies, children
the Veda expert in his own light who stood a glowing brightness
driving the firm chariot so that Pārtha and the Veda expert rose
while the whole world passed one time one day without affliction, I am without any sorrow
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, accusative, perfective aspect

ta: துயரில் சுடரொளி தன்னுடைச் சோதிநின் றவண்ண நிற்கவே
துயரின் மலியு மனிசர் பிறவியி டோன்றிக்கண் காணவந்து
துயரங்கள் செய்துதன் தெய்வ நிலையுல கில்புக வுய்க்குமம்மான்
றுயரமில் சீர்கண்ணன் மாயன் புகழ்துற்ற யானோர்துன் பமிலனே
en: The lord who escaped to enter the world of his divine status after having caused sorrows
having appeared in the birth of a human who abounds in sorrow, having come for the eye to see
while he stands the way his sorrowless glowing bright light stands
sorrowless excellent Kṛṣṇa, the trickster, while he absorbs [my] praise I am without any distress

ta: துன்பமு மின்பமு மாகிய செய்வினை யாயுல கங்களுமா
யின்பமில் வெந்நர காகி யினியநல் வான்சுவர்க் கங்களுமாய்
மன்ப லுயிர்களு மாகிப் பலபல மாய மயக்குகளா
லின்புறு மிவ்விளை யாட்டுடை யானைப்பெற் றேதுமல் லலிலனே
en: Having obtained the one who possesses this play that is pleasurable
through many many wondrous confusions, being the lasting many creatures
being the pleasing good heavens, being the joyless hot hells
being the worlds, being the deeds to be done that are sorrow and pleasure
I am without any distress

ta: அல்லலி லின்ப மளவிறந் தெங்கு மழகமர் சூழொளிய
னல்லி மலர்மகள் போக மயக்குக ளாகியு நிற்கு மம்மா
னெல்லையின் ஞானத்தன் ஞான மஃதே கொண்டெல் லாக்கரு மங்களுஞ்செ
யெல்லையின் மாயனைக் கண்ணனைத் தாள்பற்றி யானோர்துக் கமிலனே
en: The pervasive light that goes beyond the measure of painless pleasure, abiding in beauty everywhere
the lord who stands, although being confusions, as the enjoyment of the woman from the lotus blossom
the one who is boundless knowledge, the boundless trickster who takes that as knowledge
[and] does all deeds, holding on to Kṛṣṇa’s feet I am without any misery

ta: துக்கமின் ஞானச் சுடரொளி மூர்த்தி துழாயலங் கல்பெருமான்
மிக்கபன் மாயங்க ளால்விகிர் தஞ்செய்து வேண்டு முருவுகொண்டு
நக்க பிரானோ டயன்முத லாக வெல்லாரு மெவையுந் தன்னு
ளொக்கவொ டுங்கவி ழுங்கவல் லானைப்பெற் றொன்றுந் தளர்விலனே
en: The great lord with a tulsi garland, [his] form of the glowing light of flawless knowledge
getting on to him who is capable of swallowing everyone and everything so that they are
equally contained in him, the unborn one along with the smiling lord as the first
taking the form he wants, causing change by very many illusions, I will be without any slackening
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

ta: தளர்வின்றி யேயென்று மெங்கும் பரந்த தனிமுதன் ஞானமொன்றா
யளவுடை யைம்புலன் களறி யாவகை யாலரு வாகிநிற்கும்
வளரொளி யீசனை மூர்த்தியைப் பூதங்க ளைந்தை யிருசுடரைக்
கிளரொளி மாயனைக் கண்ணனைத் தாள்பற்றி யானென்றுங் கேடிலனே
en: Holding on to the feet of Kṛṣṇa, the trickster of shining brightness
the two lights, the five elements, the form, the lord of growing light
who stands without form in ways unknown to the measuring five senses
being one with knowledge, the solitary beginning that spread everywhere all the time without slackening
I am always without loss
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, second person

ta: கேடில் விழுப்புகழ்க் கேசவ னைக்குரு கூர்ச்சட கோபன்சொன்ன
பாடலோ ராயிரத் துளிவை பத்தும் பயிற்றவல் லார்க்கவ
னாடு நகரமு நன்குடன் காண நலனிடை யூர்திபண்ணி
வீடும் பெறுத்திதன் மூவுல குக்குந் தருமொரு நாயகமே
en: To those able to repeat these ten among the one thousand songs
composed by Caṭakōpaṉ from Kurukūr on Keśava of lossless excellent fame
he will give sole leadership of his three worlds, making [them] obtain liberation
making a vehicle inside goodness so that they well see both his land and hell
Those who ruled the worlds together, there being one leadership, so that [their enemies?] ran
their legs seized by black dogs, with pots that are broken(?)
will take alms in this very birth, while the great land looks on
Be saved by contemplating, so as to reach in time, the feet of sacred Nārāyaṇa
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: Be saved! Those who fetch tribute, speak [and] rule the world in this birth
they will let go of their tasty women for others to take
go into the forest with hot, flashing, bright sunlight [and] be thrashed
Hastily join the feet of Tirumāl with a red-flashing crown
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person
participial noun, imperfective aspect, plural, honorific, third person

en: Because those who sat, while kings worshipped [them], [their] heads
joined to [their] feet, while in the front yard thundering drums sounded
will go as dust joined to ashes, instantly
think you of the ankletted [feet] of Kṛṣṇa with a pefumed tulsi crown
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person
imperfective aspect, plural, honorific, third person

en: If you enter into thinking, as many as the fine [grains of] sand in the dunes
are those who passed away after ruling this earth for however many yugas
Other than [their] vanishing so that the traces of the parts of [their] houses are erased we don’t see
Humble yourseselves at the feet of the one who killed the rutting elephant with bulging feet
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person
participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: Be humble! Those who eat ambrosia uniting in pleasure with [women with] ornate
soft curls on pretty, cool, fresh, flower beds who speak about holy graces/favours
they will go while a piece [of cloth] hangs in front, while many fools degrade [them]
Live speaking the names of our Dark one with a sapphire-flashing body
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: There is no living [on] for those who have lived except for thinking
that they sink, vanishing, vanishing like bubbles in the great rains. There being an end without beginning
there is no saying those who have lived, having once lived will last. If [you want] to experience lasting
be servants of the majesty on the ocean bed, those immersed [in him]
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, plural, honorific, third person
participial noun, perfective aspect, plural, honorific, third person
participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: Be [servants]! Those who will eat yet again while women with pure soft words
beg [them], after they have eaten to satiation rice along with [food of] six flavours
because they will be troubled saying “give us one [bit of] food”
string the quality of the pretty effulgence beginning with the tulsi crown
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person
participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: Kings of meritorious full fame, even if they keep taking on the duty of giving
comply [and] let the world together be [prosperous?], those who are there without him(?)
although they will last in the fury that takes union(?), for those who return there is not return
Settle for the sacred names of the one on the hooded serpent bed
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, plural, honorific, third person
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

en: Also those who vanquish five senses, cutting off the many vessels in which they remain on earth along with attachment
[and] subdue [their] bodies in which sin remains, being those who are there without him
even if they reach flashing heaven where intoxication lasts, for them returning there is no return
Approach the ankletted [feet] of the majesty with a bird that stays on [his] banner
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person
participial noun, imperfective aspect, plural, honorific, third person

en: Even to a sage who is called the emancipation by contraction who has let go of all
much looking at [it] with [his] consciousness so as to shrink, if that benefit is not there
thinking in order to diminish will be one bond, and yet again there is no liberation
If without letting go at all [you] grip the steady lord, that is liberation
gloss: verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect
participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: “The cool Tulsi [that is the] decoration on the foot-pair
of the eminent one who took a nap on a Banyan leaf
faultless, having eaten the seven worlds, as an infant/guardian”
thus is perturbed the foolish creeper[-girl] of me [who has done] bad deeds
“The fragrant Tulsi [that is the] decoration on the good feet
of him who joined in the Kuravai [dance], transgressing propriety
with all the cowherdesses with waists thin as creepers”
thus speaks the daughter of me [who is] a woman of engulfing [past] deeds
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: “The red golden Tulsi [that is the] decoration on the red feet
to which gods [and] great sages constantly bow
taking many [verses] from the good garland of the versified Vedas”
crows the garland of me [who is] a women of murderous deeds
“The fresh golden Tulsi [that is the] decoration on the feet
of the highest, the lord, about whom babble, speaking at variance
the sectarians with faultless liberal praise”
thus recites she with broad shoulders of me with deeds that mature
“The cool Tulsi [that is the] decoration on the foot-pair
of him who danced the pot dance of the cowherds, the receiver
embracing seven bulls for Piṉṉai’s sake, to join her with [pretty] shoulders,”
thus day by day languishes my girl
gloss: pronominalised noun, masculine singular, honorific, third person

en: “The fresh golden Tulsi [that is the] decoration on the feet
of him who tore the vast area at the primordial time
becoming a boar for the sake of the beautiful dark earth girl”
thus recites the girl of me who begot [her]
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: To the cool Tulsi blossoms with flowers in [several] strands
on the feet of him who put on [his] chest, garlanded with broad babul
the girl, the woman Śrī from the ample lotus
she yields, you with bright foreheads, my foolish offspring
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person
pronominalised noun, plural, vocative, second person

en: For the cool Tulsi blossoms opening in the new rain
[that are the] decoration on the foot-pair of him, who sent arrow flames
to the city of Laṅka for the sake of twig-like Sītā
she longs. What will I do about this, you ladies?
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person

en: You ladies, you too have begotten [and] brought up a daughter
How will I speak to the fool I got?
“The conch”, “the discus”, “the Tulsi”
thus she speaks day [and] night. What will I do?
What will I do with my foolish girl? My tender one
not heeding my words and authority, you ladies
weakens, saying “for [my] soft breast with golden ornaments
the Tulsi from the anklet of Kaṇṇaṉ, on [his] chest flashing ornaments.”
Those who master these ten from the thousand of resounding praise
spoken by Caṭakōpaṉ from liberal Kurukūr as ample praise
on the anklets of our Kaṇṇaṉ that will end weakening pain
will be [part of] the good string of celestials with ample praise

ta: கோவை வாயாள் பொருட்டேற்றி னெருத்த மிறுத்தாய் மதிளிலங்கைக்
கோவை வீயச் சிலைகுனித்தாய் குலநல் யானை மருப்பொசித்தாய்
பூவை வீயா நீர்தூவிப் போதால் வணங்கே னேலுநின்
பூவை வீயா மேனிக்குப் பூசுஞ் சாந்தென் னெஞ்சமே
en: You who broke the neck of bulls for the sake of her with a kōvai-red mouth, you who bent the bow
in order to destroy the king of fortified Laṅkā, you who broke the tusk of the elephant good of family
even though I don’t bow [to you] through [all] the time, strewing flowers [and] unending water
my heart [is] the sandal paste that smears your body, which is a bilberry blossom
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person
participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person
participial noun, singular, second person, perfective aspect
concessive, conditional, negative, singular, first person

ta: பூசுஞ் சாந்தென் னெஞ்சமே புனையுங் கண்ணி யெனதுடைய
வாச கம்செய் மாலையே வான்பட் டாடை யுமஃதே
தேச மான வணிகலனு மென்கை கூப்புச் செய்கையே
ஈசன் ஞால முண்டுமிழ்ந்த வெந்தை யேக மூர்த்திக்கே
en: The sandal that is smeared is my heart, and the garland
densely made from words is the celestial silk cloth
and the action of folding my hands is the adorning ornament that is lustrous
of the unique form, our father who swallowed [and] spit out the world, the lord

ta: ஏக மூர்த்தி யிருமூர்த்தி மூன்று மூர்த்தி பலமூர்த்தி
ஆகி யைந்து பூதமா யிரண்டு சுடரா யருவாகி
நாக மேறி நடுக்கடலு டுயின்ற நாரா யணனேயுன்
ஆக முற்று மகத்தடக்கி யாவி யல்லன் மாய்த்ததே
en: Being one form, two forms, three forms, many forms
being the five senses, being the two lights, being formless
o Nārāyaṇa who slept in the sea, mounted on the serpent
A you contain [it] inside your whole body, [my] soul’s suffering is put to an end
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect

ta: மாய்த்த லெண்ணி வாய்முலை தந்த மாயப் பேயுயிர்
மாய்த்த வாய மாயனே வாம னனே மாதவா
பூத்தண் மாலை கொண்டுன்னைப் போதால் வணங்கே னேலுநின்
பூத்தண் மாலை நெடுமுடிக்குப் புனையுங் கண்ணி யெனதுயிரே
en: O Dark one from the cowherders who put an end to the life of the deceptive demoness
who gave [her] breast to [your] mouth, counting on putting an end [to you], Vāmana, Mādava
even though I don’t bow to you through [all] the time with a cool garland of flowers
my life-breath is a chaplet that decorated your tall crown with a cool flower garland
gloss: concessive, conditional, negative, singular, first person
pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person

ta: கண்ணி யெனதுயிர் காதல் கனகச் சோதி முடிமுதலா
எண்ணில் பல்க லன்களு மேலு மாடை யுமஃதே
கண்ண னெம்பி ரானெம்மான் கால சக்கரத் தானுக்கே
en: My life-breath is the chaplet, and [my] love is the countless many ornaments
beginning with the golden lustruous crown, and it is the suitable cloth
and it is the fame that is lauded unitedly by the three worlds
for the one with the time discus, our father, our lord, Kṛṣṇa
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person

ta: கால சக்க ரத்தோடு வெண்சங் கங்கை யேந்தினாய்
ஞால முற்று முண்டுமிழ்ந்த நாரா யணனே யென்றென்று
ஓல மிட்டு நானழைத்தா லொன்றும் வாரா யாகிலும்
கோல மாமென் சென்னிக்குன் கமல மன்ன குரைகழலே
en: “You who held up in [your] hand the white conch along with the time discus
Nārāyaṇa who swallowed [and] spit out the whole world” saying [and] saying so
even though you do not come at all when I call [you], placing a cry of distress
your lotus-like tinkling ankleted [feet] are the ornaments for my head
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person

ta: குரைக ழல்க ணீட்டிமண் கொண்ட கோல வாமனா
குரைக ழல்கை கூப்புவார்கள் கூட நின்ற மாயனே
உரைகொள் சோதித் திருவுருவ மென்ன தாவி மேலதே
en: O beautiful Vāmana who took the earth by elongating [your feet with] tinkling anklets
o Dark one who stood to be joined to those that fold [their] hands with tinkling anklets(?)
even though I am not able to praise you with fragrant flowers and water
your luminous form of light that is talked about is on my soul
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, plural, honorific, third person

ta: என்ன தாவி மேலையா யேர்கொ ளேழு லகமும்
துன்னி முற்று மாகிநின்ற சோதி ஞான மூர்த்தியாய்
உன்ன தென்ன தாவியு மென்ன துன்ன தாவியும்
இன்ன வண்ண மேநின்றா யென்று ரைக்க வல்லேனே
en: You who are on my soul, you the form of luminous knowledge
that stand as all, being joined to all the seven beautiful worlds
“you stand in a way such that my soul is your’s
[and] your soul I mine”, thus I can say
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, vocative, second person
pronominalised noun, genitive, singular, second person
participial noun, singular, second person, perfective aspect

ta: உரைக்க வல்லே னல்லேனு னுலப்பில் கீர்த்தி வெள்ளத்தின்
கரைக்க ணென்று செல்வனான் காதன் மைய லேறினேன்
புரைப்பி லாத பரம்பரனே பொய்யி லாத பரஞ்சுடரே
இரைத்து நல்ல மேன்மக்க ளேத்த யானு மேத்தினேன்
en: I cannot speak. When shall I go to the shore of the flood
of your unending fame? I rose in the intoxication of love
O Highest of the high with equal, o highest light without false
while former people cried out [and] praised [your] good [qualities], I too praise

ta: யானு மேத்தி யேழுலகு முற்று மேத்தி பின்னையும்
தானு மேத்தி லுந்தன்னை யேத்த வேத்த வெங்கெய்தும்
யானு மெம்பி ரானையே யேத்தி னேன்யா னுய்வானே
en: I praise and the whole world praises and furthermore
even though he himself praises while [they?] praise [and] praise him, where does that lead?
While being sweet like honey, milk, sugarcane and ambrosia
I to praised our lord in order to me to escape

ta: உய்வு பாய மற்றின்மை தேறிக் கண்ண னொண்கழல்கள்மேல்
செய்ய தாம ரைப்பழனத் தென்னன் குருகூர்ச் சடகோபன்
பொய்யில் பாட லாயிரத்து ளீவையும் பத்தும் வல்லார்கள்
வைய மன்னி வீற்றிருந்து விண்ணு மாள்வர் மண்ணூடே
en: Those who master these ten among the thousand in falseless song
by Caṭakōpaṉ from Kurukūr of the Southern king with red lotus tanks
on the bright ankletted [feet] of Kṛṣṇa, being clear about the absence of any other means of salvation
will remain in the world in eminent position [and] will rule heaven too on earth
gloss: pronominalised noun, plural, honorific, third person

ta: மண்ணை யிருந்து துழாவி வாமனன் மண்ணி தென்னும்
விண்ணைத் தொழுதவன் மேவு வைகுந்த மென்று கைகாட்டுங்
கண்ணை யுணீர்மல்க நின்று கடல்வண்ண னென்னு மன்னேயென்
பெண்ணைப் பெருமயல் செய்தாற் கென்செய்கேன் பெய்வளை யீரே
en: Sitting [and] stirring the earth she says “this [is] Vāmaṉaṉ’s earth”
worshipping the sky she gesticulates, saying “Vaikuntam, where he dwells”
standing while water rises in [her] eyes she says “he with ocean colour”, alas
To him, who caused the great confusion of my girl, what will I do
you with bangles to wear?
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, dative, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, plural, vocative, second person

ta: பெய்வளைக் கைகளைக் கூப்பிப் பிரான்கிடக் குங்கட லென்னுஞ்
செய்யதோர் ஞாயிற்றைக் காட்டிச் சிரீதரன் மூர்த்தியீ தென்னு
நையுங்கண் ணீர்மல்க நின்று நாரண னென்னு மன்னேயென்
றெய்வ வுருவில் சிறுமான் செய்கின்ற தொன்றறி யேனே
en: Folding [her] hands with bangles to wear she says “[this is] the ocean on which the lord lies”
pointing at a red sun she says “this [is] the form of the bearer of Śrī”
standing while crushing tears rise she indeed says “Nāraṇaṉ”
What my little doe of divine shape does I do not understand at all
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, present tense

ta: அறியுஞ்செந் தீயைத் தழுவி யச்சுத னென்னுமெய் வேவா
ளெறியுந்தண் காற்றைத் தழுவி யென்னுடைக் கோவிந்தன் னென்னும்
வெறிகொ டொழாய்மலர் நாறும் வினையுடை யாட்டியேன் பெற்ற
செறிவளை முன்கைச் சிறுமான் செய்கின்ற தென்கண்ணுக் கொன்றே
en: Embracing the red fire she knows she says “Acchyuta”, body unburned
embracing the blowing cool wind she says “my Kōvintaṉ”
she is fragrant with perfumed Tulsi flowers. [All] one to my eyes [is] what is done
by the little doe with tight bangles on [her] forearms, begotten by me woman with [old] Karma
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, present tense

ta: ஒன்றிய திங்களைக் காட்டி யொளிமணி வண்ணனே யென்னு
நின்ற குன்றத்தினை நோக்கி நெடுமாலே, வாவென்று கூவு
நன்றுபெய் யுமழை காணி னாரணன் வந்தா னென்றாலு
மென்றின் மையல்கள் செய்தா ரென்னுடைக் கோமளத் தையே
en: Pointing at the moon that resembles [him] she says “the one of bright sapphire colour”
looking at the hill that stands she cooes “great Māl, come!”
when she sees the rains that pour down well she dances, saying “Nāraṇaṉ”
When did he cause sweet madnesses in my tender [girl]?
gloss: participial noun, honorific, third person, perfective aspect

ta: கோமள வான்கன்றைப் புல்கிக் கோவிந்தன் மேய்த்தன வென்னும்
போமிள நாகத்தின் பின்போ யவன்கிடக் கையீ தென்னு
மாமள வொன்று மறியே னருவினை யாட்டியேன் பெற்ற
கோமள வல்லியை மாயோன் மால்செய்து செய்கின்ற கூத்தே
en: Embracing a tender pure calf she says “Kōvintaṉ grazed them”
going after a young serpent that goes she says “this [is] his couch”
I do not know at all the measure to which will come the dance [she] does, caused by Māl
by the Dark one to the tender creeper begotten by me [who is] a woman of difficult Karma

ta: கூத்தர் குடமெடுத் தாடில் கோவிந்த னாமென வோடும்
வாய்த்த குழலோசை கேட்கின் மாயவ னென்றுமை யாக்கு
மாய்ச்சியர் வெண்ணெய்கள் காணி லவனுண்ட வெண்ணெயீ தென்னும்
பேய்ச்சி முலைசுவைத் தாற்கென் பெண்கொடி யேறிய பித்தே
en: When dancers set up a pot [and] dance she runs, saying “it is Kōvintaṉ”
when she hears she sound of an excellent(?) flute, she is perplexed, saying “the Dark one”
when she sees the cowherdesses’ butter she says “this [is] the butter he ate”
[thus] the infatuation that has risen in my creeper daughter towards him who tasted the breast of the demoness
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, dative, perfective aspect

ta: ஏறிய பித்தினோ டெல்லா வுலகுங்கண் ணன்படைப் பென்னு
நீறுசெவ் வேயிடக் காணி னெடுமா லடியா ரென்றோடு
நாறு துழாய்மலர் காணி னாரணன் கண்ணியீ தென்னுந்
தேறியுந் தேறாது மாயோன் றிறத்தன ளேயித் திருவே
en: With the infatuation risen [in her] she says “all the world is Kaṇṇaṉ’s creation”
when she sees ashes applied correctly she runs, saying “the servants of tall Māl”
when she sees fragrant Tulsi blossoms she says “this [is] Nāraṇaṉ’s garland”
believing or not this brilliant [one] has opened to the Dark one

ta: திருவுடை மன்னரைக் காணி றிருமாலைக் கண்டேனே யென்னு
முருவுடை வண்ணங்கள் காணி லுலகளந் தா னென்று துள்ளுங்
கருவுடைத் தேவில்க ளெல்லாங் கடல்வண்ணன் கோயிலே யென்னும்
வெருவிலும் வீழ்விலு மோவாள் கண்ணன் கழல்கள் விரும்புமே
en: When she sees resplendent kings she says “I have seen Tirumāl”
if she sees beautiful colours she leaps, saying “he has measured the world”
all the houses of shrine-possessing gods she calls “temples to him of ocean colour”
Whether she is frightended or falls she won’t leave off the desire for the anklets of Kaṇṇaṉ
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, third person

ta: விரும்பிப் பகவரைக் காணில் வியலிட முண்டானே யென்னுங்
கரும்பெரு மேகங்கள் காணிற் கண்ணன் னென்றேறப் பறக்கும்
பெரும்புல வாநிரை காணில் பிரானுள னென்றுபின் செல்லு
மரும்பெறல் பெண்ணினை மாயோ னலற்றி யயர்ப்பிக்கின் றானே
en: When she longingly sees sages she says “he ate the vast area”
when she sees black large clouds she flies high up, saying “Kaṇṇaṉ”
when she sees the cow herd in the big field she goes after [it], saying “he is the lord”
[My] girl difficult to obtain, incessantly the Dark one makes [her] forget
gloss: causative, present tense, singular, third person

ta: அயர்க்குஞ்சுற் றும்பற்றி நோக்கு மகலவே நீணோக்குக் கொள்ளும்
வியர்க்கு மழைக்கண் டுளும்ப வெவ்வுயிர்க் கொள்ளுமெய் சோரும்
பெயர்த்துங் கண்ணா வென்று பேசும் பெருமானே வாவென்று கூவு
மயல்பெருங் காதலென் பேதைக் கென்செய்கேன் வல்வினை யேனே
en: She forgets, she looks fixedly all around, she widely casts long glances
she perspires, while [her] rain eyes brim over, she heaves hot sighs, [her] body faints
repeatedly she says “o Kaṇṇaṉ”, “o great lord, come”, she cooes
For my daughter in mad great love, what will I do, I of harsh deeds?

ta: வல்வினை தீர்க்குங் கண்ணனை வண்குரு கூர்ச்சட கோபன்
சொல்வினை யால்சொன்ன பாட லாயிரத் துள்ளிவை பத்தும்
நல்வினை யென்றுகற் பார்க ணலனிடை வைகுந்த நண்ணி
தொல்வினை தீரவெல் லாருந் தொழுதெழ வீற்றிருப் பாரே
en: Those who will learn, as good deeds, these ten among the thousand
to be sung, composed through work with words, by Caṭakōpaṉ from
liberal Kurukūr, on Kaṇṇaṉ who ends [the effects of] harsh deeds
close to Vaikuntam in the middle of goodness they will sit in distinction
for all to worship [and] rise to, in order to end [the effects of] old deeds
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, plural, honorific, third person

en: “The lord who rules, sitting in distinction, abounding in power with imperishable excellence
while [his] sovereignity goes over the seven worlds, the one who tore the mouth of the cruel horse
praise [to him],” to me who has done penance who, so saying, [my] hands fully worshipping
raised a word garland, what want will now be there in seven birth?
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, masculine, third person
participial noun, dative, perfective aspect, singular, first person

en: He on whose chest stays she with kajal eye, she who stays on the blossom
Kṛṣṇa with red beautiful large eyes, the great lord of the celstials
praising him in a musical garland with assorted words I have received [him] in [my] heart
so that all of the hot pains in the wide world will perish
gloss: participial noun, feminine singular, imperfective aspect

en: Our Acyuta who much passes the limites of imperishable pleasure
him of imperishable excellence, Kṛṣṇa with flower eyes, the great lord of the celestials
praising him as imperishable time with a musical garland I have obtained that he resides [in me]
Being attached [to him] I have passed the limits of imperishable pleasure
The lord who dwells so that the karma of those who constantly dwell [and] worship goes
he who possessesthe feathered pretty bird, the lord with the deadly discus
praising him in a musical garland with the property of [my] tongue I have obtained that he approaches
I don’t know the way he does to the soul of me who has a soul
gloss: participial noun, honorific, third person, imperfective aspect

en: The lord who shows way that are good for coping, the bull
of the celestials, him who discloses all meaning, our father
decorating [and] praising him with a word garland I have attained daily delight
while the pains of karma, before coming near like the wind, are [now] burned
gloss: participial noun, masculine singular, accusative, perfective aspect
participial noun, neuter plural, perfective aspect

en: Kṛṣṇa with big beautiful long eyes who places just a little white ash
on his black body, the great lord of the celestials
praising him in a musical garland with befitting words, for me who obtains [him in my] heart
will there be anything difficult for me from today on, now [or] ever?
gloss: participial noun, singular, dative, first person, perfective aspect

en: He who, being always one thing, stands without anybody who is equal
or more than him, he who possesses all the worlds
the lord who protected against the rain with a single mountain, we have reached
a mode [of life] of well putting word garlands on him. What want [would there be] for us?
gloss: participial noun, honorific, third person, perfective aspect
participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person
participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, masculine, accusative, third person

en: The one who is a pleasure to us and to the girl on the flower, the great lord
of those in the world and those in heaven, the great lord with feet
that bear cool lotuses, to me, who is able to create a way to speak
word garlands on him, who is now equal in wide heaven?
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, dative, first person

en: The one who stands without interruption in heaven, beyond the inside of heaven
on earth, in the place below earth, and in the eight directions
he with the curved conch in [his] broad hand, he who danced on a pot, the celestial
king, to me who is able to speak a poem on him, will there be opposition now?
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, singular, dative, first person

en: On him who, having swallowed, spit out, churned, scooped out, lied, stood
sat in distinction with the attire he took, having joined in union
stood thinking the world is his alone by the way he see [it]
I have done penance I order to spin a [poem] in generous Tamil: showers of bliss for [his] servants
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: Through these ten in the thousand composed by Kāri Māṟaṉ Caṭakōpaṉ
from the city of Kurukūr surrounded by groves of fresh flowers where the waters do not change
on the majesty from Vēṅkaṭam, the cool mountain on which the showers do not change
she who sits on the flower that does not change in perfume put an end to karma
A physian now, how will we seek [him], mothers?
By examination we understood this [is] the good pain suffered by this [girl with] bright forehead
Her mind, stirred, subsides to him who drives the chariot of miraculous
warfare that brought victory to the Five that day, he himself acting as covering
gloss: pronominalised noun, honorific, third person, accusative

en: She subsides to pain. This [is] the very great god
this [is] not the young god to whom you dance as demonesses, without playing music
If you intone, for her to hear, “the conch, the discus”
without amazement, [it] will be good. This will hit home, see
gloss: neuter singular, present tense, verbal noun

en: See this, mothers. Taking the word of this soothsayer, don’t you
doing anything, strew toddy and meat there
If you praise the anklet of the marvellous lord
[his] Tulsi crown overflowing with honey
that alone will be the precious remedy for all the pain she had
gloss: pronominalised noun, vocative, plural, second person

en: Taking thus the word of a deceitful woman that [that] be the remedy, your
preparing the [dance] floor with black rice [and] else with red rice, what [is] the use?
If you speak the name of the great god who swallowed down in one
all the seven worlds [and] spit them out again, you will get her [back]
The way of getting her [back] is not this dancing as demonesses, alas
She has become pale to [her] broad lotus eyes and her Kōvai-red mouth
Put water with white powder, along with the auspicious name
of the lord who killed the elephant in rut by [its] tusk. She will calm down
gloss: singular, feminine, third person, perfective aspect

ta: டணிய முயலின் மற்றில்லை கண்டீ ரிவ் வணங்குக்கே
en: It is not the time to calm [her], you will dance as demonesses, mothers
and the illness will not pass, it will increase, except for this:
There is nothing other than the effort to adorn [her] with ashes from the feet of his people
the Dark one with decorative sapphire-like colour, see, for the girl
gloss: pronominalised noun, vocative, plural, second person
neuter singular, present tense, verbal noun

en: As a precious remedy for [this] girl a goat and toddy are spread there
the Cuṇaṅkai is beaten [and] your shoulders are shaken, mothers
Seeing the dance of a donkey’s lip as the corn is lost, what is the use?
Bow before the people of the marvellous lord that master the Veda
gloss: pronominalised noun, vocative, plural, second person
pronominalised noun, accusative, honorific, third person

en: Without ending yourself this pain of her’s by bowing before the auspicious
feet of the great lord of the celestials, taking those who master the Veda, your
going [and], talking of blame, committing sins, mixing [and] sprinkling toddy
in between, setting up drums for song [and] dancing as demonesses
[is] baseness
gloss: pronominalised noun, plural, accusative, honorific, third person

en: Through baseness, under the drum set up by one low man there
I can’t see the falsehood of you dancing as demonesses, saying many vain [words]
This [is] the remedy for all this pain [and] protection up to the seventh birth:
according to rule praise, meditating the anklets of lord Kaṇṇaṉ
Just meditating she won’t worship any god but him
even though you say what you wish, o mothers whose shoulders are shaken
As soon as you praise intensely the king of liberal Dhvārakā
proficient in the permanent Vedas, she will dance in worship
gloss: pronominalised noun, vocative, plural, second person

en: Those able to sing, dancing Veṟis in worship, these ten among
the unswerving thousand composed by Caṭakōpaṉ from liberal Kurukūr
of unswerving old fame, whose pain ended serving him of pure sapphire colour
dancing in worship, will be free from the nature of misery
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, dative, third person

ta: சீல மில்லாச் சிறிய னேலுஞ் செய்வினை யோபெரிதான்
ஞால முண்டாய் ஞானமூர்த்தி நாராய ணாவென் றென்று
காலந் தோறும் யானிருந்து கைதலை பூச லிட்டால்
கோல மேனி காண வாராய் கூவியுங் கொள்ளாயே
en: Even though I am [only] a little one without training/discipline, karma I made, ah, it is big
If, saying [and] saying “You who have swallowed the world, Nārāyaṇa with the form of knowledge”
If I sit every time [and] put with [my] hands decorations in [your] place(?)
you don’t come so that I see [your] beautiful body, although I call take [it]
gloss: pronominalised noun, concessive, conditional, singular, first person
participial noun, singular, second person, perfective aspect

ta: கொள்ள மாளா வின்ப வெள்ளங் கோதில தந்திடுமென்
வள்ள லேயோ வையங் கொண்ட வாமனா வோவென்றென்று
நள்ளி ராவு நண்பகலு நானிருந் தோல மிட்டால்
கள்ள மாயா வுன்னை யென்கண் காணவந் தீயாயே
en: Saying [and] saying “is he my benefactor who gives without fail
a flood of pleasure that does not die when taken, is he the dwarf who took the world?”
if by full night and day I sit [and] make a noise/an appeal
fraudulent trickster, won’t you graciously come so that my eyes see you?

ta: ஈவி லாத தீவினைக ளெத்தனை செய்த னன்கொல்
தாவி வையங் கொண்ட வெந்தாய் தாமோதரா வென்றென்று
கூவிக் கூவி நெஞ்சுருகிக் கண்பனி சோர நின்றால்
பாவி நீயென் றொன்று சொல்லாய் பாவியேன் காணவந்தே
en: How many actions that are without charity have I committed?
If, saying [nd] saying “my father who expanded [and] took the world, Tāmotara”
calling [and] calling, [my] heart melting I stand while tears trickle from [my] eyes
won’t you say one thing “you wretch”, caming so that wretched I can see [you]?
Saying [and] saying “graciously stand, my father with the excellent red golden body,”
while the lotus eyes are twinkling at the front of the eye, because I have come to see
the father with a greatness that the celestials cannot esteem [and] see
what of the prattle here of me who has little fitness without shame?
gloss: verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

ta: துப்ப னேயுன் றோள்க ணான்குங் கண்டிடக்கூடுங் கொலென்று
எப்பொ ழுதுங் கண்ண நீர்கொண் டாவி துவர்ந்துவர்ந்து
இப்போ ழுதே வந்தி டாயென் றேழையே னோக்குவனே
en: Father, you with the murderous discus, when will it be possible to see
your four shoulders, mighty one who churned the deep ocean?
All the time wiping [and] wiping [my] soul with eye water
wretched me will look [at you], saying “this one time, come.”
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person

ta: நோக்கி நோக்கி யுன்னைக் காண்பான் யானென தாவியுள்ளே
நாக்கு நீள்வன் ஞான மில்லை நாடோறு மென்னுடைய
வாக்கை யுள்ளு மாவி யுள்ளு மல்லபு றத்தினுள்ளும்
நீக்க மின்றி யெங்கு நின்றாய் நின்னை யறிந்தறிந்தே
en: Looking [and] looking I will see you inside my soul
There is no long, strong knowledge of the tongue.
knowing [and] knowing you, you who stand always without leaving
in my body, soul and in the outside which is neither, every day
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person
participial noun, singular, second person, perfective aspect

ta: அறிந்த றிந்து தேறித் தேறி யானென தாவியுள்ளே
நிறைந்த ஞான மூர்த்தி யாயை நின்மல மாகவைத்து
பிறந்துஞ் செத்து நின்றிடறும் பேதைமை தீர்ந்தொ ழிந்தேன்
நறுந்து ழாயின் கண்ணி யம்மா நானுன்னைக் கண்டுகொண்டே
en: Knowing [and] knowing, believing [and] believing, putting inside my soul
the you in the full form of knowledge so as to be spotless
I have put an end to the folly in which I stumbled, being born and dying
o father with a fragrant tulsi chaplet, seeing you for myself
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, genitive, first person
pronominalised noun, accusative, singular, second person

ta: கண்டு கொண்டென் கைக ளார நின்றிருப் பாதங்கள்மே
லெண்டி சையு முள்ள பூக்கொண் டேத்தி யுகந்துகந்து
தொண்ட ரோங்கள் பாடி யாடச் சூழ்கடன் ஞாலத்துள்ளே
வண்டு ழாயின் கண்ணி வேந்தே வந்திட கில்லாயே
en: While, so that the hands of me who have seen for myself are full, taking the flowers
there are to your sacred feet, praising in all the eight directions, rejoicing [and] rejoicing
we servants sing [and] dance, in the worlds with the surrounding sea
o king with a generous tulsi chaplet, won’t you be able to come?
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, first person

ta: இடகி லேனோன் றட்ட கில்லே னைம்புலன் வெல்லகில்லேன்
கடவ னாகிக் காலந் தோறும் பூப்பறித் தேத்தகில்லேன்
மடவ னெஞ்சங் காதல் கூர வல்வினை யேனயர்ப்பாய்
தடவு கின்றே னெங்குக் காண்பன் சக்கரத் தண்ணலையே
en: I cannot put, I cannot place one thing, I cannot vanquish the five senses
being under an obligation, I cannot all the time pluck flowers [and] praise
While the heart of me fool is full of love, I with harsh karma forgetfully
grope where shall I see the majesty with the discus?

ta: சக்க ரத்தண் ணலேயென்று தாழ்ந்து கண்ணீர் ததும்ப
பக்க நோக்கி நின்ற லந்தேன் பாவியேன் காண்கின்றிலேன்
மிக்க ஞான மூர்த்தி யாய வேத விளக்கினையென்
தக்க ஞானக் கண்க ளாலே கண்டு தழுவுவனே
en: Saying “o majesty with the discus”, lowering myself while tears overflow
looking to the side, I constantly suffered, I sinner don’t see
Will I see [and] embrace with the eyes of knowledge that is suited to me
the lamp of the Vedas that is the form of abundant knowledge?
gloss: present tense, negative, singular, first person

ta: குழுவு மாடத் தென்குரு கூர்மா றன்சட கோபன்சொல்
தழுவப் பாடி யாட வல்லார் வைகுந்த மேறுவரே
en: Those able to sing [and] dance so as to embrace
these ten among the thousand of unswerving Tamil [stanzas]
spoken by Māṟaṉ Caṭakōpaṉ from southern Kurukūr with crowded mansions
on the one with lotus eyes, by [his] love that stands embracing [him]
will rise to Vaikuntam
The one whose single body controls as parts the lord who rules the bull
and the one with faces in the directions and the woman Śrī, the contrary man
linked with a weapon, determined that there be a way that the Asuras become ashes
clan by clan, we have no want for [our] sapphire darkness not seized by him
Except the want for [our] sapphire darkness, without failing in humble attitude
towards him whose broad hand [holds] the deadly discus, with broad mountain shoulders
that are like ornaments on him on whose chest the flower woman dwells, we have no want for
[our] foolish heart that is not seized by the sapphire-dark one who has taken me into [his] service
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, accusative, first person

en: Except the want for [our] foolish heart
we have no want for [our] fullness that is not seized by the tall Dark one/trickster
the highest man with big mountain shoulders who lies on a hooded-cobra bed
the very insightful small child that tasted the breast with poison to be
released by a demoness acting as a human mother
Except the want for [our] fullness
we have no want for [our] sprout colour that is not seized by the low man
[his] hand with a stick for the cows with coral on the rim of [his] garment, the black one(?)
who rejoiced in killing seven bulls in fight in order to be close to the weighty breasts
of youthful Piṉṉai with long bamboo shoulders
Except of the want for [our] sprout colour
we have no want for [our] knowledge that is not seized by the one exceeding in care
for the ocean[-girdled], he with a fragrant crown wreathed with Tulsi in nectar blossoms
who burned the city of the exalted Rakṣasa, because of her with parrot words
who was famous in [her] solitary prison
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, perfective aspect

en: Except the want for [our] knowledge
we have no want for [our intense lustre that is not seized by mischievous Māl
who took the ground by crooked taking, in the form of a short dwarf
a figure of full knowledge that spoke, setting up all the paths
for those of the wide world to know
Except the want for [our] intense lustre
we have no want for [our] striped bangles that are not seized by the one of luscious lustre
in sapphire blue, him with the right-spiralling conch, with the lusciously bright glowing discus
who rejoiced in tearing open the wide chest of intensely bright Hiraṇya
emerging [and] rising in lion form
Except the want for [our] striped bangles
we have no want for [our] girdle that is not seized by the one of wide fame
who is humbly praised by the king of the immortals, by Brahmā, by Śiva, difficult to understand
who removed affliction from the great ground, blowing so that a flaming fire entered
with great noise those who did not submit
gloss: participial noun, accusative, negative, honorific, third person

en: Except the want for [our] girdle
we have no want for [our] body that is not seized by the one who has a support in Yoga
in order to keep all the worlds well restrained, like one who sleeps on the serpent
cutting off the arm of victorious Bhāṇa, famous father of the daughter of enjoyment
with slender broad hips
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, imperfective aspect

en: uṭampiṉāṉ kuṟaiv* illā ~uyir pirinta malai+ tuṇṭam
kiṭantaṉa pōl tuṇi pala ~ā ~acurar kuḻām tuṇitt* ukanta
taṭam puṉala caṭai muṭiyaṉ taṉi ~oru kūṟ* amarnt* uṟaiyum
uṭamp* uṭaiyāṉ kavarāta ~uyiriṉāṉ kuṟaiv* ilam-ē
gloss: participial noun, neuter plural, perfective aspect

en: By these ten among the thousand in the musical garland composed without fault
by Caṭakōpaṉ from Kurukūr with a tank on him who ate curd [and] ghee
restraining in his self all the seven worlds which are without lack of lives
they will approach Vaikunta, cutting off birth, joined by harshness
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, accusative, perfective aspect

en: While those who are not close [to me] smile, while those who feel well[-disposed towards me] cry [and] lament
what are these that ripen afflictions the count of which does not become full? The nature of the world
o husband, you who churned the ocean. Without delay bestow on me your servant
a way that leads to your ankleted [feet], see, [or] a way to die
gloss: participial noun, negative, honorific, third person
participial noun, honorific, third person, perfective aspect
participial noun, singular, second person, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, singular, accusative, first person

en: Ways to die, ways to get lost what are these that who have their people
pour on top of each other, being beguiled, lying, babbling? The nature of the world
I don’t know any way that is possible, you on the serpent bed, father
Make haste with a way that calls [me], see, taking hold of me [your] servant
gloss: participial noun, perfective aspect, honorific, third person
pronominalised noun, singular, vocative, second person
pronominalised noun, singular, accusative, first person

en: I can’t bear seeing life vanish, while appreciation, the beauty of the famly
the excellent treasure of those who have their people and those with curls in which bees hum
stay behind in the house. [It is] the nature of the world, you of ocean colour. Like before
without thinking take me, [your] servant, to your feet as a servant to be called
gloss: participial noun, third person, perfective aspect
pronominalised noun, singular, accusative, first person

en: Great wealth as a fire that rises shining, saying “take”
shrouds [all] in darkness, saying “take”. What are these? The nature of the world
o donor, sapphire-coloured one. By your grace drag me, [your] servant
doing a benevolent act, on a way that leads to your ankleted [feet]
gloss: pronominalised noun, singular, accusative, first person

en: Those who stand and those who move around in the flower world [girded] by the dragging water
the living beings there undergo being broken to pieces by birth, death, sickness [and] old age
Here after this [comes] hot hell. What are these? The nature of the world
Drag me, you with sapphire colour, do not refuse me, [your] servant
gloss: participial noun, neuter plural, imperfective aspect
participial noun, neuter plural, imperfective aspect
pronominalised noun, singular, accusative, first person

en: Those who perplex, catch in strong nets, tread down, kill [and] eat
fully knowing the meaning they won’t know. What are these? the nature of the world
o you with a perfumed tulsi crown, you who have fully taken me with [bad] karma
into your servantship. Now, my rare ambrosia, graciously call [me]
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, honorific, third person
pronominalised noun, singular, masculine, third person
pronominalised noun, accusative, singular, first person
participial noun, singular, second person, perfective aspect

en: Ah! Because of your having stood without any meaning other than
you in those beings that stand and roam in this world
so that these, namely pain, old age, dying, birth [and] disease cease
just call me with [bad] karma. don’t show [me] the cruel world
gloss: participial noun, neuter plural, imperfective aspect
participial noun, neuter plural, imperfective aspect
pronominalised noun, singular, accusative, first person

en: Having removed me from the fort
of the solitary egg where live the unblinking ones whom you placed [there and] created, ammassing
the earth you had swallowed, having shown [and] hidden [yourself?], the water, fire, sky [and] wind
may you united me forever with [your] sacred feet that are difficult to unite with
in the loftiness of your rich light
gloss: participial noun, negative, honorific, third person

en: You would unite even the unblinking one with your [feet with] noisy anklets, you would make
[them] dance, acting in a way they do not worship, you on the serpert bed. I, [your] servant know that
Making [me] let go of all desire I have seen you who united me
with [your] sacred feet difficult to unite with so that I roam burdened with your sacred feet
gloss: participial noun, negative, honorific, third person
pronominalised noun, singular, vocative, second person
participial noun, perfective aspect, singular, second person

en: The pleasure that is seen by the five senses that roam about seeing, hearing
feeling, smelling [and] eating is a small pleasure without measure, difficult to be clear about
While she with bright bracelets, the lady Śrī and you keep standing
have ceased seeing the seen limit. I have attained your sacred feet
These ten among the Tamil thousand spoken at the holy feet
by Caṭakōpaṉ from ample Kurukūr, in the intent of joining the holy feet
on the holy feet, on Nāraṇaṉ, Kēcavaṉ, the highest light
will make one attain the holy feet. As one join the holy feet
gloss: neuter singular, imperfective aspect, verbal noun

ta: ஒன்றுந் தேவு முலகு முயிரு மற்றும் யாதுமில்லா
வன்று நான்முகன் றன்னொடு தேவ ருலகோ டுயிர்படைத்தான்
குன்றம் போன்மணி மாட நீடு திருக்குரு கூரதனுள்
நின்ற வாதிப்பி ரானிற்க மற்றைத் தெய்வ நாடுதிரே
en: Without one thing, god, world, living being, other life, anything
that day he created along with the four-faced one the gods, along with the world the living beings
While the primeval lord is there who stays in tall Tirukkurukūr
with with mountain-like jewel mansions, would you seek any other god?
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, third person, perfective aspect

ta: நாடி நீர்வ ணங்குந் தெய்வமு மும்மையு முன்படைத்தான்
வீடில் சீர்ப்புக ழாதிப்பி ரானவன் மேவி யுறைகோயின்
மாட மாளிகை சூழ்ந்தழ காய திருக்குரு கூரதனைப்
பாடி யாடிப் பரவிச் சென்மின்கள் பல்லுல கீர்பரந்தே
en: The temple where he stays affectionately, the primeval lord praised for [his] excellence without dissolution
he who once created you and the gods you seek out [and] bow to
Tirukkurukūr that is beautiful, being surrounded by storied mansions [and] palaces
go singing, dancing [and] reverring widely, o you of many worlds
gloss: participial noun, singular, masculine, third person, perfective aspect

ta: பரந்த தெய்வமும் பல்லுல கும்படைத் தன்றுட னேவிழுங்கிக்
கரந்து மிழ்ந்து கடந்தி டந்தது கண்டுந் தெளியகில்லீர்
சிரங்க ளால மரர்வ ணங்குந் திருக்குரு கூரதனுள்
பரன்றிற மன்றிப் பல்லுலகீர் தெய்வ மற்றில்லை பேசுமினே
en: You who cannot understand although you have seen [him], along with creating the gods that are spread out
and many worlds, swallow [them], hide [them], spit [them] out, cross [them and] scoop [them] up
apart from the highest form in Tirukkurukūr where the immortals
bow with [their] heads, o you of many worlds, there is no other god. Speak!
gloss: neuter singular, perfective aspect, verbal noun
neuter singular, perfective aspect, verbal noun

ta: பேச நின்ற சிவனுக் கும்பிர மன்றனக் கும்பிறர்க்கு
நாய கனவ னேக பாலநன் மோக்கத்துக் கண்டுகொள்மின்
றேச மாமதிள் சூழ்ந்தழ காய திருக்குரு கூரதனு
ளீசன் பாலோ ரவம்ப றைதலென் னாவதி லிங்கியர்க்கே
en: He alone is the leader of Śiva, Brahmā and the others who are there
while you speak [of them]. See for yourself the good deliverance from the skull [bowl]
Talking an evil about the lord in Tirukkurukūr that is beautiful, being surrounded by
radiant big walls, what will it be for those [who worship] the linga?
gloss: participial noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect
pronominalised noun, dative, honorific, third person

ta: இலிங்கத் திட்ட புராணத் தீருஞ் சமணருஞ் சாக்கியரும்
வலிந்து வாதுசெய் வீர்களு மற்றுநுந் தெய்வமு மாகிநின்றான்
மலிந்து செந்நெல் கவரி வீசுந் திருக்குரு கூரதனுள்
பொலிந்து நின்றபி ரான்கண்டீ ரொன்றும் பொய்யில்லை போற்றுமினே
en: You from the purāṇas based on the linga and you who forecefull hold dispute
with Jaina devotees and Buddha devotees, he stands as your god too
See the lord who prosperously stands in Tirukkurukūr where they abundantly
wave fans of red paddy. There is not one lie. Praise [him]
gloss: participial noun, imperfective aspect, plural, honorific, second person

ta: போற்றி மற்றோர் தெய்வம் பேணப் புறத்திட் டும்மையின்னே
தேற்றி வைத்ததெல் லீரும் வீடு பெற்றாலுல கில்லையென்றே
சேற்றில் செந்நெல் கமல மோங்கு திருக்குரு கூரதனு
ளாற்ற வல்லவன் மாயங் கண்டீர தறிந்தறிந் தோடுமினே
en: While you praise [and] honour another god there is placing you outside
[and] clearly putting you thus. If you all attain liberation the world is no [more]. Thinking so
look at the wonders of the one able to comfort Tirukkurukūr, high
red paddy [and] lotuses in the mud. Knowing [and] knowing that run
gloss: verbal noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect

ta: ளாடு புட்கொடி யாதி மூர்த்திக் கடிமை புகுவதுவே
en: Running [and] running, being born in all the births, singing, dancing [and] humbling yourselves
before another god, having mounted the path of many generations, see:
[there is] entering into servantship to the primordial form with a dancing bird banner
in Tirukkurukūr where [he] stands while the celestials join [and] praise [him]
gloss: verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

ta: மிக்க வாதிப்பிரா னிற்க மற்றைத் தெய்வம் விளம்புதிரே
en: Taking, so that he escaped that day, even the lord who smiled at Mārkaṇḍeya
who had entered [and] seen [him] because of the servantship [is] the grace of Nārāyaṇa
while the excellent primeval lord stands in Tirukkurukūr with a fence
of mango blossoms [and] broad screwpine, will you speak of anyother god?
gloss: verbal noun, neuter singular, perfective aspect

en: Taking into [your] minds
Tirukkurukūr that is beautiful, being surrounded by fertile cool fields
where abides the primeval lord who is difficult to measure [and] see
on the part of the six doctrines that are proclaimed, although they are those, and [any] other
put knowledge [there], if you undertake to go, [he] taking you so that you escape

ta: உறுவ தாவ தெத்தேவு மெவ்வுல கங்களு மற்றுந்தன்பான்
மறுவின் மூர்த்தியோ டொத்தித் தனையு நின்றவண் ணநிற்கவே
செறுவில் செந்நெல் கரும்பொ டோங்கு திருக்குரு கூரதனுள்
குறிய மாணுரு வாகிய நீள்குடக் கூத்தனுக் காட்செய்வதே
en: Undertaking [that] is possible. While he stands in the manner that he stands as ever so much
being equal with [his] flawless form, in any god, in all the worlds and in others
acting as servants to the tall pot dancer who is the intended(?) glorious form
in Tirukkurukūr high with red paddy along with sugarcane in fields
gloss: verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect
verbal noun, neuter singular, imperfective aspect

ta: ஆட்செய்த தாழிப்பி ரானைச் சேர்ந்தவன் வண்குரு கூர்நகரா
